job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Job Summary: Leads cross-functional and cross-opco teams of professionals through all phases of the project lifecycle. Manages and directs projects or initiative to ensure that project(s) are delivered on time, within budget and meeting or exceeding customer expectations. Manages either of the following: Single major initiative, defined as a project that is approved and prioritized on the FedEx Project Approval Committee portfolio or a strategic corporate initiative, or multiple projects of various sizes

Essential Functions

  • Adheres to project standards and requirements including the Global Development Process or Everest processes. Ensures all projects impacting FedEx operations follows the FedEx Organizational Change Management (OCM) framework and requirements for the project
  • Ensures scope of project is clearly defined, approved, and has a documented management level sponsor. Develops, manages, tracks progress of, and updates project plan to meet the approved requirements/scope defined for the project. Escalates project issues to upper management.
  • Creates and manages the project schedule by defining tasks and determining the durations, sequencing, and resources needed.
  • Estimates project spending, provides input on budgeting, and controls cost throughout the project lifecycle. Defines and manages project plan to meet the approved scope of the project. Ensures changes in scope are reviewed and approved by project team and sponsors.
  • Defines and tracks success and accuracy metrics for the project to ensure FedEx Quality standards are enforced. Leads cross-functional team(s) to ensure all team members have clearly defined roles and responsibilities while monitoring the progress and performance.
  • Communicates project status to team members and project sponsors on a consistent basis. Ensures effective communication and training is provided to all impacted stakeholders in accordance with FedEx OCM process.
  • Manages the purchase and acquisition of products or services to meet project deliverables in adherence with FedEx policy.
  • Ensures development of risk plan and mitigation strategy. Monitors execution of that strategy. Ensures that Business Requirements Specifications (BRS) and FedEx Work Requests (FWRs) are created to support business needs within the project.
  • Collaborates and maintains a working relationship with vendors and customers as required by the project.
  • Performs other duties as assigned


Minimum Education
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Science, Business, Finance, or related field required. In addition to minimum experience, high school diploma or GED and four (4) years of experience in a technical or professional position is accepted in lieu of degree.

Minimum Experience
Five (5) years experience required in a technical or professional environment with at least two (2) years of leading cross-functional projects.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Software skills, including use of Microsoft Office software and web-based applications. Verbal and written communication skills necessary to communicate with all levels of management.
  • Presentation skills necessary to facilitate training and/or deliver informational sessions to groups and/or individuals.
  • Time management and organizational skills necessary to manage multiple projects, appropriately prioritize workload, plan for resources to meet deadlines and goals, and respond to day-to-day functional needs.
  • Ability to anticipate and identify problems and use sound judgment and fact-based analysis to develop effective and efficient solutions. Knowledge of concepts, practices, policies and procedures related to field operations

job.title: Data Engineering Lead, Singapore
job.description:
About the job

Data Engineering Lead

At ofi, we are on a mission to leverage data to drive innovation and business transformation. We are looking for a Data Engineering Lead to spearhead our data engineering team and contribute to our mission of delivering data-driven solutions. As a Data Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for managing the data engineering team and overseeing the design and implementation of our data infrastructure. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure the seamless flow and integrity of data across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

Data Infrastructure Management:


  • Design and Build Data Architecture: Construct robust data pipelines in the Snowflake environment (hosted in MS Azure) to support scalable data ingestion, transformation, and delivery.

  • Data Collection and Integration: Develop systems to collect data from various sources (including SAP ERP, Salesforce, other IT systems as well as OT systems) using real-time or batch ingestion technologies, ensuring it is accurately integrated into the Snowflake platform.

  • Data Transformation: Implement processes to normalize, aggregate, and transform data into a format suitable for analysis and reporting.

  • Performance Optimization: Optimize data retrieval and query performance within Snowflake, ensuring efficient operation of data pipelines.

  • Collaboration with Stakeholders: Work closely with business leaders to understand company objectives and align data engineering strategies accordingly.

  • Governance and Security: Partner with legal and cyber security teams to maintain high standards of data governance and security, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.

  • Innovation and Improvement: Stay abreast of the latest technology innovations in data engineering and apply them to improve existing systems and processes.

  • Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.


Data Quality Assurance:


  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to establish data quality rules, standards, and thresholds for the data domains.

  • Develop and implement data quality metrics /standards, processes, and tools to monitor and improve the quality and accuracy of data across systems and platforms.

  • Implement data validation and cleansing routines to identify and rectify data errors, duplicates, outliers, and missing values, leveraging data quality tools such as Informatica.

  • Conduct data profiling and analysis to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and anomalies and work with relevant teams to address them.

  • Implement data lineage and metadata management solutions to track the origin, transformations, and usage of data across the organization.


Requirements


  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Technology, etc.

  • Proven 6+ years of experience in data engineering, with 2+ years as the Data Engineering Lead.

  • Knowledge of SAP ERP (S4HANA and ECC) including its integration with Snowflake.

  • Functional understanding of customer experience, manufacturing, supply chain, and financial concepts

  • Proficiency in data pipeline tools and technologies, particularly within the Snowflake ecosystem.

  • Extensive experience with SQL databases and multiple programming languages.

  • Experience in working with data quality tools such as Informatica.

job.title: Solutions Architect
job.description:
Job Summary: Under limited guidance, work at the business unit level developing the end-to-end solution architecture for significant initiatives in partnership with key business and IT stakeholders.

Essential Functions

Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.

  • Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
  • Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
  • Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
  • Oversee the management of non-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
  • Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
  • Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to other IT architects to develop their skills and expertise in solution architecture leadership and execution.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information Systems, business and/or equivalent formal training or work experience.

Minimum Experience

Five (5) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment. A related advanced degree may offset the related experience requirement

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with Sparx EA.
  • Working knowledge of established application design frameworks and UML.
  • Ability to successfully influence change.
  • Strong problem solving and communication skills.
  • Experience with implementing architecture principles and patterns.
  • Spring Boot, Java, Angular, GitHub, Gradle, Splunk, AppDynamics, OAuth, relational database, NoSQL, and Linux skill-sets desired.
  • Experience with SOA, API First, service design and development.
  • Experience architecting and implementing distributed systems that process large data volumes with low latency.
  • Working knowledge and experience developing large scale distributed systems.
  • Experience working within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and XP development practices.
  • Experience in Continuous Integration/Deployment (DevSecOps) environment preferred.
  • Experience in setting application architectural direction and disaster recovery models.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Time management and prioritization skills.
  • Independent worker but also able to collaborate with others.
  • Project management, system analysis and design experience is helpful.
  • Proactive, great attention to detail, results-oriented problem solver.
  • Ability to balance long term goals against immediate concerns in the areas of code maintainability, developer productivity and customer experience.
  • Thinking outside the box, willingness to battle for good ideas, willingness to collaborate with team members.

job.title: Sr Exec Advisor Technology
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:

Provide expertise and leadership through the planning, coordination, and execution of strategic initiatives, organizational priorities, and special projects across Freight Technology. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executive leadership by driving alignment, enabling execution, and facilitating collaboration across Technology, Operations, Commercial, and Corporate functions. The role operates as a strategic advisor, trusted partner, and force multiplier for the Senior Vice President, serving as a key connector across executive leadership, functional teams, and individual contributors to ensure priorities are executed effectively and consistently. The Sr. Executive Advisor partners closely with the Technology Chief of Staff and other executive leaders to drive alignment, accountability, decision-making, and execution of enterprise priorities.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide strategic counsel and execution support to Senior Executive leadership on key business, technology, and organizational priorities.
  • Partner with the Senior Vice President to establish, communicate, and monitor strategic objectives, transformation initiatives, and critical business outcomes.
  • Establish and manage the executive operating cadence for the Senior Executive’s organization, including leadership meetings, business reviews, strategic planning cycles, decision tracking, action management, and organizational scorecards.
  • Collect, analyze, and synthesize information to support executive decision-making, including development of recommendations, trade-off analyses, and executive briefings.
  • Serve as a central coordination point for strategic escalations, ensuring issues are properly assessed, stakeholders are aligned, options are evaluated, and decisions are prepared for executive review.
  • Coordinate and drive execution of cross-functional initiatives that span multiple technology organizations and business functions.
  • Facilitate alignment between Technology and business stakeholders, ensuring priorities, dependencies, risks, and decisions are effectively managed.
  • Represent the Senior Vice President in meetings, governance forums, planning sessions, and cross-functional initiatives as required.
  • Develop executive-level communications, presentations, briefing materials, business reviews, and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead special projects and strategic initiatives that advance organizational effectiveness, technology modernization, operational excellence, and business value realization.
  • Identify execution risks, organizational barriers, and interdependencies; proactively drive resolution and escalation as appropriate.
  • Establish program governance, reporting mechanisms, milestones, and performance indicators to ensure successful initiative delivery.
  • Support annual planning, portfolio reviews, operating reviews, investment prioritization, and strategic roadmap development.
  • Foster collaboration across all levels of the organization, including executive leadership, management teams, technical professionals, and business stakeholders.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple teams to ensure alignment to enterprise objectives and technology strategy.
  • Partner closely with the Technology Chief of Staff and other Executive Advisors to ensure consistent execution of enterprise priorities.
  • Analyze organizational trends, performance metrics, and strategic opportunities to support executive decision-making.
  • Assist leadership in driving change management, organizational readiness, and stakeholder engagement efforts.
  • Act as a liaison between Technology, Operations, Commercial, and Corporate functions to improve communication, transparency, and execution.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

DISCLAIMER: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Technology Management, Organizational Leadership, or related field
  • Seven (7) years of relevant experience in strategic planning, program leadership, project management, business operations, technology leadership support, consulting, or organizational transformation
  • Experience supporting executive leadership and driving cross-functional initiatives in complex environments preferred.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to work directly with officers, executive leadership, and senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced project and program management capabilities, including governance, risk management, dependency management, and executive reporting.
  • Strong business and technology acumen, with the ability to understand technology concepts and translate them into business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive alignment and execution across organizations without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, including executive-level written, verbal, and visual communication.
  • Proven ability to create, prepare, and deliver presentations for executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information into concise, actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly visible environment.
  • Experience building partnerships across business and technology organizations.
  • Strong change management and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Experience and ability to use Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and related collaboration tools.

JOB CONDITIONS:

  • Some travel is required.
  • Must be available during various business hours to support strategic initiatives and executive priorities as needed.

job.title: Operations Strategy Consultant Advisor
job.description:
In this role, you will work as a strategic consultant to FedEx business domains, serving as a subject matter expert, providing thought leadership and pushing business leaders to identify out-of-the-box opportunities that drive progress within the P&L. You will play a vital role in defining and advancing the organization's strategies and initiatives to deliver value, ensuring that the right level of rigor and visibility is provided for desired outcomes. You will collaborate closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to brainstorm solutions and influence business decisions using a fact-based approach, take new ideas from concept to execution, and communicate with key stakeholders.

Essential Functions

About the Role - The Operations Strategy Consultant, Advisor is a visionary leader and trusted thought-partner, driving transformational initiatives across diverse business domains. This role spearheads the identification and execution of innovative opportunities to advance strategic objectives and maximize value delivery across the full initiative life cycle. Acting as a key liaison among cross-functional teams, the advisor fosters collaboration, ensures adherence to best-in-class program management standards, and delivers insightful reporting and presentations on program progress. With a sharp focus on strategy and execution, this position is instrumental in shaping organizational success and long-term growth.

  • In-depth knowledge and ability to provide subject matter expertise on FedEx operational networks and/or business functions. Specific areas are Airline, Service Excellence, Commercial, Global Clearance, Transformation.
  • Strategic Program Leadership – Oversees large-scale initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives and driving transformational impact.
  • Risk Management & Problem Resolution – Identifies potential challenges, proactively mitigates risks, and escalates critical issues when necessary.
  • Program Planning & Execution – Develops and implements comprehensive program plans, defining goals, objectives, and success metrics.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Team Collaboration – Builds strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and seamless execution.
  • Change Management & Organizational Adoption – Leads efforts to drive adoption of new processes, fostering a culture of innovation and adaptability.
  • Financial Oversight & Value Optimization – Evaluates program investments, ensuring cost-effectiveness and maximizing strategic value delivery.
  • Data-Driven Insights & Reporting – Creates actionable reporting and executive presentations, offering visibility into program progress, risks, and successes.
  • Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement – Establishes KPIs, tracks progress, and drives ongoing enhancements for sustained success.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, or a related discipline.

Minimum Experience

Seven (7) to ten (10) years of experience in business operations, transportation, logistics, or related fields, with leadership experience.

Domicile Information

This position can be domiciled anywhere in the United States within Central and Eastern time zones. The ability to work remotely within the United States may be available based on business need.

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Posting Template: Engineering Manager

About FedEx Dataworks:

Born out of FedEx, a pioneer that ships nearly 20 million packages a day and manages endless threads of information, FedEx Dataworks is an organization rooted in connecting the physical and digital sides of our network to meet today's needs and address tomorrow's challenges.

We are creating opportunities for FedEx, our customers, and the world at large by:

  • Exploring and harnessing data to define and solve true problems
  • Removing barriers between data sets to create new avenues of insight
  • Building and iterating on solutions that generate value
  • Acting as a change agent to advance curiosity and performance
  • At FedEx Dataworks, we are making supply chains work smarter for everyone

Summary: Takes ownership and responsibility for the support the design, build, test and maintain data pipelines at big data scale. Leads a team responsible for modeling and development to support operations initiatives, strategic programs and new products and solutions. Strong background and experience in the use of advanced descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, prescriptive and ensemble modeling, advanced statistical techniques, and complex mathematical tools. Uses expertise to lead a team that initiates and delivers projects and develops end-to-end solutions that drive business results, including proofs-of-value for new business problems and production-ready solutions for operations and customer-facing products. Understands and ensures development of solutions supporting the movement of data and information assets following API-First / Service-Oriented Architecture principles. Advances Dataworks’ broad capabilities to use and deploy cutting edge data science and machine learning tools in Dataworks projects, platforms and products. Provides expert consultation and thought leadership to senior management. Mentors other team members to drive results and effectively collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver business goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to the team, helping them overcome any challenges and make informed decisions
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, and operations to ensure seamless delivery of solutions
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
  • Drive the successful execution of solution implementation projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standard
  • Identify and mitigate risks, escalate issues as needed, and provide regular updates to stakeholders

Skills / Abilities:

  • Knowledge in implementing large scale solutions and managing multiple team members
  • Knowledge in Azure or similar, data engineering and application development
  • Knowledge in Agile practices

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, a related quantitative field such as Engineering or Mathematics or equivalent formal training or work experience
  • Extensive knowledge in data engineering and machine learning frameworks including design, development and implementation of highly complex systems and data pipelines
  • Extensive knowledge in Information Systems including design, development and implementation of large batch or online transaction-based systems
  • Strong understanding of the transportation industry, competitors, and evolving technologies
  • Experience providing leadership in a general planning or consulting setting.
  • Experience as a leader or a senior member of multi-function project teams
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • A related advanced degree may offset the related experience requirements

job.title: Cloud Engineer - All Levels
job.description:
As a Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for the deployment, integration, and management of private, public, and/or hybrid cloud platform services supporting the development of complex analytical applications at enterprise scale. You'll demonstrate networking and security protocol knowledge to ensure a safe and scalable environment, while protecting accessibility to data assets residing within. You will leverage your expertise in developing infrastructure as code using scripts, templates, blueprints, workflows, CI/CD orchestration tools, and other automation technologies in the spirit of speed and consistency.

Continuous collaboration will be an important aspect of this role as you will work with a variety of architects and peer engineering teams to ensure our cloud solutions meet the organization's needs.

Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Use infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform to provision and support reliable, fault tolerant and scalable cloud-based storage, compute, and networking services
  • Build metrics and monitoring solutions to track latency and overall health of the system.
  • Work with data governance and data lake teams to implement access controls to data and services
  • Work closely with Security and SRE teams
  • Follow information security guidelines to secure all cloud-based resources.
  • Create and maintain source code repository and gated CI/CD pipelines to build, package and deploy applications
  • Selecting and deploying appropriate CI/CD tools
  • Strive for continuous improvement and build continuous integration, continuous development, and constant deployment pipeline (CI/CD Pipeline)
  • Managing periodic reporting on the progress to the management and the customer
  • Defining and setting development, test, release, update, and support processes for DevOps operation
  • Monitoring the processes during the entire lifecycle for its adherence and updating or creating new processes for improvement and minimizing the wastage

  • Excellent understanding of Ruby, Python, Perl, Java, Json Yaml, IaC, Terraform
  • Configuration and managing databases such as MySQL, Mongo
  • Excellent troubleshooting
  • Working knowledge of various tools, open-source technologies, and cloud services
  • Awareness of critical concepts in DevOps and Agile principles

job.title: Adv. Slack Platform & Svc Cloud
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for the day-to-day configuration, governance, and operational health of both Slack and Service Cloud, and services as the primary administrator for Agentforce agent deployment across collaboration and service channels. Role also covers Experience Cloud portal administration as the self-service platform matures.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Oversee Slack workspace administration including channel governance (naming conventions, lifecycle policies, archival rules), permission structures, guest access controls, and compliance-grade retention settings appropriate for a publicly traded company.
  • Configure and maintain Slack SSO integration with Okta (SAML 2.0), DLP policy enforcement within Slack, eDiscovery/legal hold configurations, data residency compliance, and audit log monitoring in coordination with IT/IAM and the VP CISO.
  • Administer Slack Workflow Builder configurations for commercial teams: deal stage notifications, territory alerts, case escalation workflows, approval routing, and CRM-triggered channel notifications from Sales Cloud and Data Cloud.
  • Serve as the primary administrator for Agentforce agent deployment in Slack and Service Cloud channels, including SDR Agent, Sales Coach Agent, Service Agent, Customer Insights Agent, and Employee Help Agent. Manage agent configuration, permission sets, testing, and monitoring.
  • Oversee Service Cloud administration for the Rise and Shine clone and lead the Wave 2 full-Service Cloud modernization: case management configuration, omni-channel routing rules, entitlement and SLA configuration, escalation rules, and Knowledge Base administration.
  • Administer Experience Cloud portal environments including community user management, portal page configuration, identity flows (Anonymous to Manage to Unified), and self-service case submission and knowledge access.
  • Configure and oversee Service Cloud Voice / telephony integrations, including Five9 BYOT integration (Wave 2), CTI adapter configuration, call logging, screen pops, and click-to-dial functionality.
  • Oversee Slack app ecosystem governance: evaluate, security-review, and deploy approved integrations (Tableau embeds, Zoom, task management connectors) using scoring with documented business cases. Enforce no-unapproved-app policy.
  • Administer Slack-to-Salesforce integration configurations including real-time CRM notifications (deal stage changes, territory alerts, case escalations), account collaboration channels, and Data Cloud-triggered alert routing.
  • Track and report on Slack platform health metrics using the AIM framework: Adoption (license utilization, active workspace ratio, workflow adoption rate), Integrity (channel hygiene, bot/integration reliability, SSO compliance), Metrics (time-to-response for deal alerts, workflow completion rates).
  • Oversee Agentforce agent monitoring and optimization: track agent response accuracy, escalation rates, user satisfaction, and conversation volumes. Configure agent guardrails, escalation thresholds, and feedback loops.
  • Oversee vendor relationships for Slack ecosystem partners, telephony providers (Five9), and Agentforce licensing. Serve as the technical contact for vendor integration troubleshooting and contract compliance.
  • Support UAT execution for Slack integration releases, Service Cloud deployments, and Agentforce agent launches. Maintain test scripts, environmental configurations, and rollback procedures.
  • Partner with the Level 5 Principal Administrator on cross-cloud security requirements affecting Slack and Service Cloud, including Shield coverage gap mitigation and DLP enforcement in collaboration channels.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science or related field
  • Five (5) years of Salesforce administration experience with at least 2 years administering Slack Business+ or Enterprise Grid in an enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated experience with Service Cloud administration including case management, omni-channel routing, entitlement management, and Knowledge Base configuration.
  • Hands-on experience configuring Slack governance: channel naming standards, retention policies, permission models, eDiscovery workflows, and audit log monitoring.
  • Experience with Slack SSO integration (Okta SAML 2.0 or equivalent) and enterprise DLP policy configuration within Slack.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce-to-Slack integration patterns including CRM notification architecture, Workflow Builder implementations, and channel automation.
  • Experience with or strong aptitude for Agentforce, conversational AI agents, or AI chatbot deployment within collaboration or service platforms.
  • Understanding of Experience Cloud portal administration including community user management, identity flows, and self-service configuration.
  • Salesforce certifications required: Salesforce Administrator. Preferred: Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Slack Certified Admin.
  • Experience managing platform vendor relationships and evaluating third-party integrations with documented security review processes.
  • Experience administering Agentforce agents (SDR Agent, Sales Coach, Service Agent) or equivalent AI agent platforms.
  • Familiarity with telephony/CTI integrations (Five9, Amazon Connect, or equivalent) with Service Cloud Voice.
  • LTL freight, logistics, or supply chain industry experience.
  • Experience with Experience Cloud portal deployment for customer self-service.
  • Background in enterprise collaboration tool migrations or platform consolidation projects.

Preferred Skills & Knowledge:

Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Administration, including user management, security model, workflows, and platform configuration. Salesforce certifications highly preferred, including Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, and Service Cloud Consultant. Proven expertise in Slack Administration, including workspace management, app integrations, automation, and governance. Relevant certification such as Slack Certified Admin strongly preferred. Deep knowledge of Salesforce Service Cloud, including case lifecycle management, entitlements, omni-channel routing, and service console optimization. Experience designing and supporting case management processes to improve customer support efficiency and user experience. Ability to integrate and optimize workflows between Slack and Salesforce to enhance collaboration and real-time service operations. Experience configuring and maintaining automations, alerts, and notifications across both Salesforce and Slack platforms. Strong understanding of business process design, with the ability to translate operational needs into scalable system solutions. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and implement service-focused solutions. Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex, enterprise support environments. Familiarity with data management, reporting, and dashboards to drive service performance insights.?

Work CONDITIONS:

  • Some travel required

job.title: Decision Support Analyst
job.description:
TITLE:

Decision Support Analyst

LOCATION:

Detroit, MI

FOCUS:

Data & Technology

REPORT TO:

Director, Campaign engineering

GROUP:

Technology


ABOUT RAPP

WHO WE ARE

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As a global next-generation precision marketing agency, we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that values diversity and emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.

Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.

Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

OUR CLIENTS

From creating inspiring experiences behind the wheel, to defining the future of online learning, and everything in between, we provide smart solutions for companies like Toyota, AAA, PNC Bank, US Army, University of Phoenix and more.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Decision Support Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in supporting our marketing operations by leveraging Adobe Campaign Classic to design, build and optimize audiences for personalized omni-channel campaigns. This role requires a blend of analytical skills, technical expertise, and marketing knowledge to drive impactful decisions and enhance customer engagement and marketing performance.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Audience Segmentation and Targeting:

  • Develop and manage audience segmentation strategies to support personalized marketing campaigns.

  • Utilize Adobe Campaign Classic (v7/v8) and or AEP, AJO to create, maintain, and optimize audiences for multi-channel campaigns.

  • Data Analysis and Insights:

  • Analyze customer data to uncover insights and trends that inform audience strategies.

  • Conduct performance analysis of campaigns and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.

  • Collaboration:

  • Work closely with marketing, data science, Analytics, and IT teams to ensure alignment on audience strategies and campaign execution.

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals and translate them into actionable audience strategies.

  • System Management:

  • Maintain and ensure the integrity of data within Adobe Campaign Classic, from initial audience build all the way through to reporting and optimization.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to audience builds and segmentation.

  • Documentation and Reporting:

  • Document processes, workflows, and best practices related to audience building.

  • Create detailed reports to communicate findings, metrics, and insights to stakeholders.
    QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Educational Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in a similar role, with a focus on audience segmentation and campaign management

  • Proven expertise in Adobe Campaign Classic is required (Adobe campaign expert business practitioner or adobe campaign developer certification preferred)

  • Technical Skills:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and database management.

  • Experience leveraging Javascript in ACC to control workflows operations and query critical schemas.

  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (PowerBI) is a plus.

  • Experience working with data engineering solutions (Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue) is a plus.

  • Exposure to Databricks (notebooks, spark/python, automations, versioning) is a plus.

  • Analytical Skills:

  • Ability to analyze large datasets and extract actionable insights.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a marketing or customer engagement role.

  • Familiarity with other marketing automation tools and platforms.

  • Understanding of data privacy regulations (CCPA, GDPR) and their impact on audience building.



  • OUR HYBRID WORKING MODEL
    RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

job.title: Senior IT Vendor Management Analyst
job.description:
Senior IT Vendor Programs Analyst, Enterprise IT Vendor Programs

155 Harlem Avenue, Glenview, IL (Corporate HQ)
Since its founding more than 100 years ago, ITW has become one of the world’s leading diversified manufacturers of specialized industrial equipment, consumables, and related service businesses. We place a high premium on the development of innovative solutions–most of which are developed in tandem with our customers. And we continue to ensure that our customers receive timely, cost-effective service for the innovative products we provide.
ITW’s differentiated business model is composed of a set of unique core capabilities: our proprietary 80/20 business process, customer-back innovation, and our well-known decentralized entrepreneurial culture. These capabilities are unmistakably ITW—and key to our longevity and strong performance.
ITW’s products and solutions are at work all over the world, in deep-sea oil rigs, aerospace technology, bridges and wind turbines, healthcare, the spaces in which we live and work, the cars we drive, and the mobile devices we rely on. We are never, whether we know it or not, more than a few steps from an innovative ITW solution.
ITW (NYSE: ITW) is a Fortune 200 global multi-industrial manufacturing leader with revenues totaling $12.6 billion in 2020. The company’s seven industry-leading segments leverage the unique ITW Business Model to drive solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns in markets where highly innovative, customer-focused solutions are required. ITW’s approximately 43,000 dedicated colleagues around the world thrive in the company’s decentralized and entrepreneurial culture. www.itw.com. We are conveniently located across from the Metra commuter rail, with access to an on-site gym, café, and active employee resource groups.
As a member of ITW’s IT Vendor Management team, the Senior IT Vendor Programs Analyst will report directly to the Manager, Enterprise IT Vendor Management.
The Senior IT Vendor Programs Analyst will establish, maintain, and evaluate vendor relationships to drive value and efficiencies for our decentralized ITW businesses. Aligning priorities with Enterprise stakeholders, the Analyst will develop and support IT programs that are easy to adopt, targeted to mid-market operational needs, and deliver reliable results.
The Senior IT Vendor Programs Analyst supports vendor relationships, negotiations, and performance management for defined IT suppliers.
Areas of Responsibility:

  • Collaborate with ITW Segment and Division stakeholders, other Corporate IT team members, Legal, and other functions to identify, develop, and maintain effective IT vendor programs
  • Educate and interpret IT vendor contracts for respective ITW business segments and stakeholders
  • Investigate IT vendor program issues reported by Division or Corporate IT personnel and coordinate steps for resolutions, including management escalation as appropriate
  • Negotiate IT vendor contract terms, conditions, modifications, and renewals while working with key stakeholders to ensure that their requirements are met
  • Conduct market analysis, evaluating product against business requirements, crafting the deal from contracts to pricing, preparing data for annual reviews, and driving vendor compliance to agreements (SLA’s metrics, performance monitoring)
  • Utilize IT and contract knowledge to assist in driving efficiencies, value, and cost savings in contract negotiations and vendor management
  • As needed, develop Statements of Work (SOW) and manage RFI/RFP/RFQ’s related to vendor programs
  • Develop/coordinate Enterprise communications relevant to IT vendor programs, including new program announcements or webinars, contract changes or updates, vendor roadmaps, program terminations, etc.
  • Measure program performance via metrics monitoring, SLA review, vendor scorecards, and market data research for value optimization and/or cost reductions and makes recommendations accordingly.
  • Understand relevant market trends and vendors. Track, gather, and analyze market and industry data to determine product and service roadmaps
  • Build and leverages relationships and networks across the organization. Uses indirect influence to persuade others and gain support within the businesses.
  • Maintain and enhance strong relationships with current and potential strategic partners through formal and informal interactions.
  • Apply key ITW principles to drive on-going vendor management program improvement and adoption of preferred IT vendor program in ITW divisions


Key Competencies and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Information Technology or a related field
  • 5+ years IT Vendor Management and contract negotiation experience or equivalent
  • IT operational experience strongly preferred
  • 3+ years of experience with sourcing processes including RFX’s (RFP’s, RFI’s, and RFQ’s),
  • Experience managing business technology requirements, project plans, and project financials
  • Business acumen combined with IT knowledge of hardware, software, services, and telecom
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to balance and effectively prioritize a large set of diverse vendors simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to communicate information clearly and concisely at multiple levels
  • Keen attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving skills; Proficient in analyzing and manipulating data in Excel
  • Possess a strong intellectual curiosity with advancements in information technology and their business application
  • Exceptional collaboration and relationship building skills, including adaptability, flexibility, and driving for consensus
  • Result oriented
  • Customer focused

job.title: Manager, International Accounting & Finance - Mexico
job.description:
General Summary:

This position will support and manage financial operations of the International Growth organization in Colombia. Central to this role is the partnership with in-country Brokers of Record to develop and maintain financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and accounting operations. The right person for this role will be tenacious, inquisitive, and extremely analytical. They must be able to manage competing priorities while remaining agile, and above all, able to hit the ground running.

Major Duties & Responsibilities:


  • Partner with the International Growth team, providing analysis and reporting. This includes providing key metrics and analyses, such as:

  • Monthly reporting, including transaction and agent tracking, revenue forecasting, OPEX tracking and analysis, and cash flow

  • Contributing to the monthly rolling forecast for the International entities

  • Attend monthly meetings with business partners for financial reviews.

  • Financial Operations: Supervising, coordinating, and maintaining processes for GL Systems, AP/AR back office, Cash Management tracking, payroll, financial reporting, taxation reporting, and audit support

  • Manage, train, and continuously collaborate with the outsourced accounting firm to ensure all accounting duties are performed timely and accurately

  • Brokerage operations support, including financial compliance

  • Collaborate and partner with cross-functional teams to identify and implement potential operational efficiencies and cost savings.

  • Deal with all required International Transactions from a Financial and Legal Perspective

  • Ensure Monitoring of Corporate Governance, Fiduciary Duties and All Statutory Requirements of All Managed Entities within the region are met

  • Manage upload and filing of all Corporate and Company Documentation and Records, and ensuring that Company Fidelity Fund Certificates and Principal FFC’s and Audits are appropriately maintained

  • Other ad-hoc duties, as required

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Experience:


  • 8+ years professional work experience related to key responsibilities outlined above

  • BA/BS in Finance, Economics, or closely related disciplines

Skills & Abilities:


  • 8+ years relevant experience in a Finance or Accounting department

  • Strong understanding of accounting processes and procedures, particularly in relation to a real estate brokerage

  • Understanding of the life-cycle of a real estate transaction

  • Advanced Excel, including complex/nested formulas.

  • Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.

  • Tenacious personality; someone who is not afraid to ask the hard questions.

  • Fluency in oral and written Spanish and English

job.title: Enterprise Architect
job.description:
Enterprise Architect – Data and AI

Job Profile Summary:

The Enterprise Architect - Data & AI is responsible for designing and implementing scalable data architectures and AI solutions across Azure cloud and on-prem environments. This role focuses on ensuring that data platforms and AI models are integrated seamlessly into the organization’s technology stack, while fostering a culture of reusability, scalability, and innovation. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in both cloud-native and legacy data systems, with a proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and deliver data-driven solutions that meet business needs.

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement data architectures that support the deployment of AI models, ensuring scalability, security, and performance across both Azure cloud and on-prem environments.
  • Drive the integration of AI solutions with existing data infrastructures, ensuring seamless compatibility between legacy systems and modern cloud-native platforms.
  • Lead efforts to modernize data systems, transitioning from on-prem legacy architectures to cloud-native data lakes, warehouses, and advanced analytics platforms.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure that AI models and data platforms are aligned with business goals and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Foster a product engineering mindset within the data architecture teams, ensuring that data solutions are built with reusability, flexibility, and scalability in mind.
  • Implement best practices for data governance, security, and compliance, ensuring that all data architectures meet regulatory requirements and protect sensitive information.
  • Oversee the integration of DevOps practices into data pipelines and AI solution deployment, ensuring automation, efficiency, and continuous improvement across the organization’s data ecosystem.
  • Communicate complex technical architectures and AI strategies to senior leadership, ensuring alignment with the broader enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  • Responsible for decisions/priorities regarding the overall enterprise's architecture.
  • Translate business needs into architectural solutions (current and target state) and defining solutions to problems through application of information technology.
  • Facilitate the establishment and implementation of standards/guidelines that direct integration of multiple platforms.
  • Develop/document the framework for integration/implementation for changes to architectural standards.
  • Determine architecture solutions that meet performance, scalability, reliability and security needs.
  • Provide technical guidance to project team.
  • Coach the development of Jr. IT architects
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Skills

  • Technologies: Expertise in Azure services, Databricks, relational databases, document stores, key value stores, streaming and messaging systems, Lakehouse architecture, data warehouses, ETL pipelines, and AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.).
  • Cloud Expertise: Strong experience with Azure cloud-based data architectures, including data storage, processing, and AI integration.
  • On-Prem Expertise: Proven experience modernizing legacy data systems such as JMS, DB2 and Oracle, with a focus on transitioning to cloud-native data platforms.
  • AI/ML Integration: Deep knowledge of integrating AI models into existing data infrastructures and deploying them across hybrid environments.
  • Data Governance and Security: Expertise in data governance, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and implementing robust security practices across both cloud and on-prem environments.
  • DevOps for Data: Experience integrating DevOps practices into data pipelines, ensuring automation, efficiency, and continuous delivery of data-driven solutions.

Additional Job Description

Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training.

Minimum Experience

Five (5) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment.

job.title: Advisor, IT Governance, Risk and Compliance
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for spearheading the enterprise AI governance and security program. Position sits within the InfoSec Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) organization; and for developing and implementing the AI cybersecurity governance frameworks.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, implement, and operationalize enterprise-wide InfoSec AI cybersecurity governance framework and risk reviews in close partnership with other InfoSec SMEs, Platform Owners and AppDev.
  • Align corporate AI security practices and frameworks with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) and applicable legal, regulatory, and cybersecurity standards.
  • Develop, deploy, and manage an automated review system for enterprise AI security compliance, including the handling of protocols for unapproved AI network activity.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Application Security, Data Security, Data Governance, and Application Development teams to review solutions, establish AI tool parameters, and clearly convey security compliance requirements.
  • Stay abreast of rapid industry advancements in generative and agentic AI to translate emerging threats into actionable GRC processes.
  • Evaluate risk profiles of third-party enterprise AI assets and software platforms to align with centralized corporate inventory of approved vs. unapproved models and integrations.
  • Prepare materials and present AI risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and program maturity roadmaps to executive leadership.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures
  • Perform other duties as required

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.
  • Five (5) years’ experience in information technology, cybersecurity, GRC, technology risk, application security or data privacy.
  • Knowledge of enterprise technology, governance functions, framework structures, and the operational application of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Proven background in Application security and/or data security environments.

job.description:
Position Description:

As the Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise Partner Marketing, you will support advisor-facing product marketing and enablement initiatives for Ren’s enterprise partner programs, including Morgan Stanley, Edward Jones, and other strategic institutional relationships.

This role works with guidance from senior partners and leadership to translate Ren’s platform capabilities, charitable solutions, and strategic priorities into partner-specific campaigns, communications, and advisor engagement programs that align with each firm’s unique workflows and ecosystem.

You will work closely with Enterprise Relationship teams, Product Marketing, Product, and Operations to support partner growth, advisor adoption, and strategic initiatives across influential firms in wealth management.

You will collaborate with Enterprise Relationship teams, Product Marketing, Product, and Operations to support partner growth, advisor adoption, and strategic initiatives across influential firms in wealth management.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Enterprise Partner Strategy & Activation

  • Support advisor-facing enablement and marketing strategies for enterprise partner programs
  • Contribute to the development of partner-specific campaigns, collateral, presentations, and engagement frameworks
  • Support growth initiatives tied to enterprise relationships, identifying opportunities to expand advisor adoption and platform usage

Advisor Campaigns & Engagement

  • Execute campaigns and programs that increase advisor engagement, adoption, and retention
  • Tailor positioning, messaging, and experiences to align with enterprise partner workflows, segmentation, and advisor models
  • Support advisor education initiatives in partnership with Product Marketing and Enablement teams
  • Track campaign performance and contribute to measurement and optimization efforts based on performance insights

Strategic Partner Support

  • Act as a strategic marketing partner to Enterprise Relationship Managers
  • Lead support for high-priority partner initiatives, presentations, and growth opportunities
  • Translate product launches, platform enhancements, and operational changes into clear, actionable partner communications

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product, Operations, Launch PMMs, and Relationship teams to deliver initiatives
  • Ensure enterprise feedback loops into product marketing and broader strategy
  • Support cross-functional initiatives focused on improving advisor experience, onboarding, and engagement

Insights & Optimization

  • Synthesize feedback from enterprise partners and advisor interactions
  • Identify patterns, friction points, and engagement opportunities
  • Refine messaging and activation strategies based on field insights

AI & Innovation Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of enterprise marketing and enablement initiatives
  • Use AI-driven insights to identify advisor engagement patterns, segmentation opportunities, and growth signals
  • Apply personalization strategies across partner communications and campaigns

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field (MBA a plus)
  • 3-5 years of experience in product marketing, partner marketing, or B2B marketing (financial services or wealth management preferred)
  • Experience supporting enterprise partner or institutional marketing initiatives
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and adapt messaging to diverse audiences
  • Proven ability to translate complex products, platforms, and concepts into clear, compelling narratives and scalable programs
  • Experience collaborating on cross-functional initiatives across Product, Sales, Relationship Management, and Operations
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with experience using data to inform decisions and optimize performance
  • Experience defining and measuring campaign effectiveness, advisor engagement, and adoption metrics
  • Exposure to AI tools and marketing technologies preferred

job.title: Sr. Engineering Manager (Backend, Trading Systems)
job.description:
Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're on a mission to empower traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Over the last 20 years, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. In the last five years alone, our user base has grown by 400% to over 1.9 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

What you’ll do:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced engineering leader to head our Evaluation Services Engineering team. In this role, you will lead a mission-critical team that powers the infrastructure and tools behind a rapidly growing segment of our business—enabling prop trading evaluation firms on the NinjaTrader/Tradovate platform.

The Eval Squad builds the core product surface, APIs, admin tools, risk systems, and onboarding infrastructure used by third-party vendors to launch, operate, and scale their evaluation services. Our mission is to empower vendors to build successful evaluation businesses while ensuring a world-class experience for their traders.

As a leader in our technology organization, your team’s work will shape the foundation of our B2B SaaS strategy and directly impact vendor success, trader outcomes, and revenue growth.

In this role you will:

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional engineering team (backend, full-stack, and contractors), fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and agility
  • Oversee multiple critical workstreams that support, grow, and provide impact to traders and B2B business partners alike
  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders across Product, Solutions Engineering, Data, QA, and Support to deliver impactful solutions for vendors and evaluation traders
  • Drive engineering delivery, architecture, and operational readiness for the platform components under your domain, including the risk engine, trading permission systems, middleware dashboards, and admin consoles
  • Partner with Product leadership on roadmap and prioritization aligned to business growth and vendor needs
  • Hire, develop, and retain top engineering talent to support the growth and evolution of the Eval Squad
  • Uphold engineering quality and execution standards, including code reviews, test coverage, release pipelines, observability, and incident response

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in modern software development, with 5+ years in engineering management roles
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling B2B SaaS or platform products, ideally involving APIs and user-facing dashboards
  • Strong backend system design and distributed systems experience; familiarity with GCP, BigQuery, WebSockets, and REST APIs preferred
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional agile teams and delivering products from inception to production
  • Experience managing teams across geographies and working with contractors or embedded function groups
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable presenting technical ideas to both engineers and executives
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (fintech, trading, brokerage) is a plus

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in futures trading, evaluation trading, or prop firm ecosystems
  • Familiarity with Tradovate or NinjaTrader APIs, dashboards, and middleware
  • Background in risk management systems or trading account orchestration

Compensation:
The salary range for this role will be $190,000 - $220,000 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 15%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).

Our Core Benefits Include:

  • Generous PTO
  • 7 Paid Holidays Annually + 5 Conditional Holidays Annually
  • 1 Service Day Annually
  • 401k with 3.5% Company Match
  • Paid Parental Bonding Leave
  • Health, Vision, Dental Coverage
  • Life and Disability Insurance Covered 100% by NinjaTrader

Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for the day-to-day configuration, governance, and operational health of both Slack and Service Cloud, and services as the primary administrator for Agentforce agent deployment across collaboration and service channels. Role also covers Experience Cloud portal administration as the self-service platform matures.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Oversee Slack workspace administration including channel governance (naming conventions, lifecycle policies, archival rules), permission structures, guest access controls, and compliance-grade retention settings appropriate for a publicly traded company.

  • Configure and maintain Slack SSO integration with Okta (SAML 2.0), DLP policy enforcement within Slack, eDiscovery/legal hold configurations, data residency compliance, and audit log monitoring in coordination with IT/IAM and the VP CISO.

  • Administer Slack Workflow Builder configurations for commercial teams: deal stage notifications, territory alerts, case escalation workflows, approval routing, and CRM-triggered channel notifications from Sales Cloud and Data Cloud.

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Agentforce agent deployment in Slack and Service Cloud channels, including SDR Agent, Sales Coach Agent, Service Agent, Customer Insights Agent, and Employee Help Agent. Manage agent configuration, permission sets, testing, and monitoring.

  • Oversee Service Cloud administration for the Rise and Shine clone and lead the Wave 2 full-Service Cloud modernization: case management configuration, omni-channel routing rules, entitlement and SLA configuration, escalation rules, and Knowledge Base administration.

  • Administer Experience Cloud portal environments including community user management, portal page configuration, identity flows (Anonymous to Manage to Unified), and self-service case submission and knowledge access.

  • Configure and oversee Service Cloud Voice / telephony integrations, including Five9 BYOT integration (Wave 2), CTI adapter configuration, call logging, screen pops, and click-to-dial functionality.

  • Oversee Slack app ecosystem governance: evaluate, security-review, and deploy approved integrations (Tableau embeds, Zoom, task management connectors) using scoring with documented business cases. Enforce no-unapproved-app policy.

  • Administer Slack-to-Salesforce integration configurations including real-time CRM notifications (deal stage changes, territory alerts, case escalations), account collaboration channels, and Data Cloud-triggered alert routing.

  • Track and report on Slack platform health metrics using the AIM framework: Adoption (license utilization, active workspace ratio, workflow adoption rate), Integrity (channel hygiene, bot/integration reliability, SSO compliance), Metrics (time-to-response for deal alerts, workflow completion rates).

  • Oversee Agentforce agent monitoring and optimization: track agent response accuracy, escalation rates, user satisfaction, and conversation volumes. Configure agent guardrails, escalation thresholds, and feedback loops.

  • Oversee vendor relationships for Slack ecosystem partners, telephony providers (Five9), and Agentforce licensing. Serve as the technical contact for vendor integration troubleshooting and contract compliance.

  • Support UAT execution for Slack integration releases, Service Cloud deployments, and Agentforce agent launches. Maintain test scripts, environmental configurations, and rollback procedures.

  • Partner with the Level 5 Principal Administrator on cross-cloud security requirements affecting Slack and Service Cloud, including Shield coverage gap mitigation and DLP enforcement in collaboration channels.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science or related field

  • Five (5) years of Salesforce administration experience with at least 2 years administering Slack Business+ or Enterprise Grid in an enterprise environment.

  • Demonstrated experience with Service Cloud administration including case management, omni-channel routing, entitlement management, and Knowledge Base configuration.

  • Hands-on experience configuring Slack governance: channel naming standards, retention policies, permission models, eDiscovery workflows, and audit log monitoring.

  • Experience with Slack SSO integration (Okta SAML 2.0 or equivalent) and enterprise DLP policy configuration within Slack.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce-to-Slack integration patterns including CRM notification architecture, Workflow Builder implementations, and channel automation.

  • Experience with or strong aptitude for Agentforce, conversational AI agents, or AI chatbot deployment within collaboration or service platforms.

  • Understanding of Experience Cloud portal administration including community user management, identity flows, and self-service configuration.

  • Salesforce certifications required: Salesforce Administrator. Preferred: Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Slack Certified Admin.

  • Experience managing platform vendor relationships and evaluating third-party integrations with documented security review processes.

  • Experience administering Agentforce agents (SDR Agent, Sales Coach, Service Agent) or equivalent AI agent platforms.

  • Familiarity with telephony/CTI integrations (Five9, Amazon Connect, or equivalent) with Service Cloud Voice.

  • LTL freight, logistics, or supply chain industry experience.

  • Experience with Experience Cloud portal deployment for customer self-service.

  • Background in enterprise collaboration tool migrations or platform consolidation projects.

job.title: ServiceNow HR Knowledge Manager
job.description:
e are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented ServiceNow HR Knowledge Manager to lead and manage the design, maintenance, and optimization of our HR knowledge content within the ServiceNow platform. This role will play a critical part in driving the success of our global HR Service Delivery initiatives, ensuring knowledge content is accurate, accessible, and user-centered.
In addition to managing day-to-day knowledge operations, this role will bring a strong background in content design, supporting our Content Strategist and acting as a backup when needed. The ideal candidate combines expertise in knowledge management, content design principles, governance, and ServiceNow platform functionality.
Knowledge Management (Primary Responsibilities):

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of HR knowledge articles within ServiceNow, including creation, review, approval, publishing, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Partner closely with HR subject matter experts (SMEs), content contributors, and global stakeholders to ensure content accuracy, alignment to taxonomy, metadata, and compliance standards.
  • Maintain knowledge governance processes to ensure consistency, quality, and adherence to global standards.
  • Develop and monitor content KPIs (e.g., article usage, search performance, deflection rates) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as liaison between HR, IT, ServiceNow platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure effective integration of knowledge management in the HR Service Delivery ecosystem.

Content Design & Strategy (Secondary Responsibilities):

  • Apply content design best practices to ensure HR knowledge articles are intuitive, easy to consume, and tailored to employee personas.
  • Partner with the Content Strategist to co-develop content templates, style guides, and writing standards.
  • Conduct content audits, gap analyses, and usability reviews to continuously improve the employee digital experience.
  • Act as a backup and collaborate closely with the Content Strategist to support major content projects, migrations, and redesigns.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with platform administrators, UX/UI teams, and HRIS to align knowledge architecture with the broader digital employee experience vision.
  • Support change management and adoption activities related to knowledge management processes.
  • Provide training, coaching, and support to content contributors and SMEs globally.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in knowledge management, content design, technical writing, or related fields.
  • Strong experience managing HR knowledge within ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD) or similar platforms.
  • Solid understanding of knowledge-centered service (KCS) principles, metadata/taxonomy management, and content lifecycle governance.
  • Experience in content design, plain language writing, user experience, and accessibility standards.
  • Ability to translate complex HR policies and processes into clear, actionable, and user-friendly content.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with attention to detail and a passion for content quality.
  • Strong collaboration, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow reporting, performance analytics, and AI Search capabilities is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Communications, Information Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

  • KCS Certification
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or HRSD certification
  • Experience supporting global HR content for a diverse, multinational workforce.
  • Experience with AI-driven content optimization or generative AI tools in knowledge management.

Minimum Education
Bachelor's degree in business, technical, analytical, or disciplines required.
Minimum Experience
Five (5) years experience in planning, analysis and project leadership, which includes management of all phases of cross-functional project teams.A related advanced degree may offset the related experience requirements.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Demonstrated experience in leading major corporate initiatives. Strong human relations, communications, problem solving, project management, analytical and organizational skills. Proven record of effective communication with stakeholders and senior management. Excellence knowledge of project management applications (Microsoft Project, Smartsheet or similar) and knowledge of technical and business issues related to financial systems, business, finance, accounting and related processes and software.
