job.title: Executive Assistant - NY
job.description:
Executive Assistant

at Brunswick Group (View all jobs)
New York, New York, United States

Brunswick Group is looking for a highly organized and proactive individual to join the team as Executive Assistant in our New York location. In this role, you will serve as an administrative business partner and provide excellent daily support of four-to-five client-facing Partners in the firm, who may or may not be based in your local office.

The nature of this role requires you to maintain a firm understanding of our goals as a firm and the role of our partnership in order to play an active role in supporting those efforts. While providing administrative support, you would also have the opportunity to serve as a thought partner and driver of our Partner’s efforts, while working in stride with the local Office Manager, Administrative Assistants and collaborating with the U.S. administrative team and other like-minded specialists on the professional services team across the U.S.

Duties and Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  • Provide seamless Executive Assistant support to appointed Partner-level staff, including but not limited to: flawlessly managing complex calendars and providing strategic administrative support to increase efficiencies and productivity of the assigned Partners.
  • Take a proactive approach to the role in order to identify and solve for potential challenges related to scheduling, travel and other daily activities before they arise
  • Understand the nature of our firm’s work, how the leadership team functions and your role in facilitating that work in order to seamlessly coordinate with other executive assistants across the firm globally.
  • Coordinate with Administrative Assistant pooled support on travel bookings and expense processing for staff
  • Serve as informal mentor for Administrative Assistants and support their development opportunities as appropriate
  • Understand and prioritize Partners’ time to ensure they are well positioned to excel, and remain nimble in order to adjust as needed
  • Build strong rapport with Partners and client contacts
  • Respond to emails and requests in a timely fashion, including outside of standard work hours, as appropriate
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously and follow through on all associated details
  • Participate in continuing education and training opportunities provided by the firm
  • Possess keen awareness to business strategies and acts as project manager where necessary for charges’ client teams, coordinating specific team assignments and projects
  • Identify and execute on areas of improvement and increase administrative efficiencies
  • Able to draft documents, edit presentations and assist with other preparations of presentation materials for Partners or clients
  • Provide support and coverage to the Office Manager or other administrative staff as needed
  • Maintain strong internal relationships with U.S. and international Brunswick team
  • Perform related duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Minimum seven (7) to nine (9) years of administrative or operations experience in a fast-paced, confidential, professional services environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong project management experience
  • Detail-oriented
  • Ability to manage schedules seamlessly across time zones (domestic and international)
  • Client service-orientation, exhibit discretion with confidential client matters
  • Work well independently and strategically as a team player
  • Multi-tasker who exercises keen time management skills
  • Resourceful, problem solver
  • Always maintain professionalism, specifically when dealing with senior business figures
  • Possess “think on your feet” ability and showcase impeccable judgment
  • High emotional intelligence and strong personal impact
  • Take on challenges readily and bring a truly proactive approach to duties
  • Swift to adapt to various personalities and situations
  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred
  • Intermediate to Advanced software skills (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint for PC, Windows 2000, Internet)

While not required, the following would be a plus:

  • International work experience or knowledge
  • Multi-lingual
  • Communications industry knowledge/business acumen

The Firm

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a strategic advisory firm focused on critical issues and critical stakeholders. Our purpose is to help our clients play their role in the world successfully.

We advise on critical issues and critical stakeholders at the center of business, politics and society, and help our clients – the leaders of large, complex organizations – understand and navigate these interconnected worlds.

Brunswick is one firm globally, operating as a single profit center. This allows us to respond seamlessly and effectively to clients’ needs wherever they are in the world.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement

Maintaining and strengthening a diverse workforce and inclusive workplace are pillars of Brunswick’s culture and key to our future success. Valuing and supporting every colleague as an individual while helping them reach their full potential is critical to attracting and developing our greatest strength – our people. By embracing our differences and diverse perspectives we create richer experiences within our firm and enhance the quality of the ideas and advice that we deliver to our clients.

Background

Founded in London in 1987, Brunswick’s global partnership has grown organically to 27 offices in 18 countries. We began as a M&A and financial communications firm and, over time, expanded our capabilities to provide expert advice to our clients on a range of business critical issues. We invested in new offices, sector teams and practice groups including investor engagement; shareholder activism; governance; regulatory and public affairs, including geopolitical; crisis; litigation; social issues including climate change and diversity, equity and inclusion; cybersecurity, data and privacy; employee engagement; digital communications; opinion research and analysis, and; creative services.

Our CEO is Neal Wolin, based in Washington, D.C. Our Chairman is Sir Alan Parker, based in London.

The Americas

In the U.S., we have offices in Chicago, Dallas, New York, San Francisco and Washington, D.C. In Brazil, we have an office in Sao Paulo. We advise clients on, among other things, domestic and cross border M&A, IPOs, activism, capital markets and investor relations, public and regulatory affairs, geopolitical issues, litigation, crisis, cyber, employee engagement, digital, opinion research and on broader reputation campaigns.

Colleagues in the U.S. are drawn from a variety of backgrounds and consist of in-depth industry and sector experts from banking, law, accounting, politics, government, journalism and the media, consulting and elsewhere. Our U.S. CEO is Nik Deogun.

For more information on Brunswick, including our offices and client offers, please visit our website: www.brunswickgroup.com

Compensation & Benefits

The applicant who is selected for this position will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits:

In New York City, the range of base compensation will be: $100,000 - $115,000.

If an offer is extended to an applicant in New York City, the applicant will be paid in line with this range and based on the applicant’s experience and qualifications. This range applies only to the New York City position, and salaries in other offices and regions will vary based on an applicant’s experience and qualifications, as well as the competitive landscape.

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual performance and the overall performance of the Firm.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Paid Time Off: Vacation and sick leave, as well as paid Bank Holidays. Firm-sponsored 401K Plan with 3% safe harbor contribution of base and bonus – immediate vesting.

Other: Career training and development opportunities and employee discounts.

Job Title: SAP Logistics Support (SAP- EWM-MM)
Location: Amsterdam

We are a global leader in food & beverage ingredients. Pioneers at heart, we
operate at the forefront of consumer trends to provide food & beverage manufacturers
with products and ingredients that will delight their consumers. Making a positive
impact on people and planet is all part of the delight. With a deep-rooted presence in
the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling
better quality, and more reliable, traceable and transparent supply. Supplying products
and ingredients at scale is just the start. We add value through our unique,
complementary portfolio of natural, delicious and nutritious products. With our fresh
thinking, we help our customers unleash the sensory and functional attributes of
cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices so they can create naturally good food &
beverage products that meet consumer expectations. And whoever we’re with,
whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

innovative thinking skills. Responsible for supporting day to day IT functions associated with
SAP- EWM / MM and related SAP modules. This position is responsible for gathering and

platforms and tools.

business for how to leverage SAP products and tools.

transactions for a multinational business

Custom definitions, EWM Shipment integration, TU Loading,
• Should have hands-on optimizing resource utilization, master data, RF customization,

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
Human Capital Research Corporation (HCRC), a Chicago-area based higher education research consultancy specializing in enrollment, retention and market development is seeking individuals with outstanding technical and creative talents to join us as a full time Data Engineer. Working with HCRC’s development team, this position will work in a collaborative environment building ETL pipelines and converting locally hosted workstreams to a cloud framework.
Working in close concert with HCRC’s other developers and analytic and senior consultants, responsibilities for the position include:

  • Designing and developing new software to tools automate data conditioning, data display related to HCRC’s analytics
  • Maintenance, quality-control management, error correction and enhancements related to the performance and user-interface of existing applications
  • Assessment, testing and validation of existing and newly prototyped procedures
  • Communicating and providing exemplary best practices documentation
  • Managing concept, design, production and implementation of new applications over the course of the entire development life cycle
  • Providing on-going communication and consultation with internal stakeholders concerning status of existing projects and prospective new projects
  • Provide end-user support and related training to ensure programs are utilized properly and smoothly, and deficiencies and requisite improvements are resolved on a timely basis
  • Technical needs assessed as it relates to the design and performance of HCRC’s existing suite of analytic products and identification of new product opportunities


Required Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

  • Experience working on a multidisciplinary team to solve data engineering problems including analytics and business intelligence
  • Understanding of ETL strategies and building data pipelines
  • Knowledge of python, javascript, typescript, HTML, and CSS required
  • Proficiency with a database system such as SQL, DynamoDB, or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud technologies including Glue, Lambda, and S3
  • Working knowledge of React, PySpark
  • Preferred experience with NoSql and typescript
  • Demonstrated experience of data warehousing concepts and approaches
  • Full software development life cycle experience
  • Demonstrated experience in Service Orientated Architecture
  • Experience with GIT or related source control
  • Self-Starter - Inquisitive, motivated and creative
  • Capability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Knowledge of data visualization a plus
  • Experience working in higher education administration or research a plus

Education and Training Background
Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with a minimum of two years of experience in a related position.
Compensation
Compensation is commensurate with education and experience. In addition, we offer a very competitive benefits package of vacation, insurance (health, dental, vision, life), retirement plan with employer contribution, flexible spending accounts and eligibility for year-end bonus.
Application
US citizens and those authorized to work in the US are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor H1b candidates at this time. Interested parties should forward a detailed cover letter and resume to HRresume@humancapital.com. Resumes forwarded without a cover letter will not be considered.
Human Capital Research Corporation:
Established in 1991, HCRC is among the nation’s preeminent education research consultancies. Using a wide array of econometric and statistical research methods and rubrics, HCRC provides colleges and universities with a wide range of strategic information services concerning all aspects of the college enrollment process and student experience from first contact on through to graduation and beyond.

job.title: Client Retention Specialist
job.description:
As a Client Retention Specialist, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the satisfaction and loyalty of our existing customers. You will be in contact with clients who may be considering canceling or downgrading their services, and your goal will be to address their concerns, resolve issues, and provide personalized solutions to retain their business. Your responsibilities will include:

Responsibilities:

  • Client Engagement: Initiate outbound calls to existing clients to understand their needs, offer support, and provide guidance on our products and services.
  • Retention Strategies: Collaborate with the team to develop and implement effective retention strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and minimize attrition.
  • Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve customer concerns and issues in a timely and effective manner, ensuring a positive customer experience.

job.title: Counsel, Corporate
job.description:
Position Description:

The Corporate Counsel is a key member of Ren's legal Team within the Legal, Compliance & Risk department This role provides high-level strategic legal support and general corporate counsel to senior management, the General Counsel, and the Associate General Counsel. The Counsel, Corporate serves as the Corporate Secretary for Renaissance Charitable Foundation (RCF), provides governance support across the nonprofit entities and collaborates with a wide range of internal stakeholders on matters including M&A, corporate transactions, data privacy, employment, and intellectual property. This role operates with significant independence and is expected to serve as a strategic legal partner across the organization.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide M&A and corporate transaction support, including due diligence, negotiation, and legal integration.
  • Serve as principal legal advisor to senior management on strategy, risk, and compliance matters, providing thought leadership across multiple functions and influencing key organizational decisions.
  • Review externally facing documents, including websites, RFPs, and marketing materials, for legal risk.
  • Collaborate with the Compliance and Risk team on consumer protection, data protection and privacy, regulatory frameworks, and governance matters.
  • Assist in intellectual property management and protection.
  • Support crisis response and management efforts.
  • Monitor and advise on evolving corporate legal landscape to keep leadership informed.
  • Serve as the primary legal resource across People Ops, Product, IT, Revenue, and Finance teams, applying judgment to evaluate complex issues, identify risk, and recommend courses of action with organization-wide implications.
  • Serve as Corporate Secretary for RCF, supporting the RCF Board of Directors and other RCF Officers.
  • Provide governance support to ARC entities and act as a resource for corporate governance matters.
  • Manage and oversee outside counsel as necessary.
  • Leverage AI tools and technology to streamline legal research, document drafting, due diligence workflows, and contract review, advancing the team's operational efficiency.

Education & Experience:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school; admission to the bar in at least one state required.
  • 5+ years of legal experience in-house or at a law firm with corporate, M&A, or transactional focus; broad cross-functional exposure preferred.
  • In-depth knowledge of M&A, corporate finance, governance, and corporate transactions.
  • Experience with employment, intellectual property, and/or data protection and privacy is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to advise and influence senior leadership.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders including executives and board members.
  • Ability to represent Ren professionally in interactions with ARC entities, sponsoring organizations, and outside counsel.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: experience using AI-assisted tools for legal research, contract analysis, or document drafting; commitment to staying current with emerging legal technology.
  • Operates with a high degree of independence; exercises wide latitude in determining approaches to complex legal matters and is recognized internally as a subject matter expert. Ability to direct the work of outside counsel and serve as a mentor and resource to colleagues on cross-functional legal matters.

Ren is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Mgr-Fin Tech & Transformation
job.description:
While this position is eligible to work remotely if the successful candidate is located outside the Memphis, TN or Harrison, AR areas, the candidate must reside within 50 miles of a FedEx Freight location within the continental U.S.
If the successful candidate is located in the Memphis, TN or Harrison, AR areas, the candidate will be required to work a hybrid schedule, working three days per week in the office.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for leading delivery, operations, modernization, and continuous improvement for critical Finance technology capabilities supporting FedEx Freight. Help translate enterprise Finance technology strategy into executable road maps, reliable platforms, disciplined delivery plans, and measurable business outcomes. Key role in building Finance technology capabilities for FedEx Freight operating model, and needs while advancing long-term simplification, modernization, automation, governance, data quality, and operating model maturity.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage the roadmap, delivery, operational reliability, and continuous improvement of assigned Finance technology platforms, applications, integrations, and data capabilities, including ERP, EPM, Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Procurement, reporting, and related systems.
  • Translate Finance and enterprise technology priorities into actionable delivery plans, release plans, backlog priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead Finance technology modernization initiatives, including platform simplification, system migrations, integrations, automation, application rationalization, process enablement, and data quality improvements.
  • Manage end-to-end delivery for assigned programs and initiatives, including scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, issues, testing, deployment readiness, adoption, and transition to support.
  • Partner with Finance leaders and business stakeholders to understand business processes, control requirements, reporting needs, operational pain points, and future capability requirements.
  • Ensure Finance systems and related integrations are secure, resilient, scalable, supportable, auditable, and compliant with SOX, data, regulatory, security, and company control requirements.
  • Support Finance technology priorities, including capability, systems separation, operating model maturity, process redesign, data ownership, and transition from shared services to independent capabilities.
  • Establish and manage governance routines for assigned platforms and initiatives, including intake, prioritization, status reporting, risk management, performance metrics, operational reviews, and executive-ready communications.
  • Lead, coach, and develop technical team members, product owners, analysts, engineers, contractors, and delivery partners; build accountability, collaboration, and a high-performance culture within the team.
  • Manage vendor, systems integrator, and third-party partner delivery performance, ensuring accountability for quality, cost discipline, contractual commitments, risk management, and business outcomes.
  • Drive operational excellence for production Finance systems, including incident management, problem management, release coordination, monitoring, root-cause analysis, service performance, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with architecture, security, infrastructure, data, and enterprise platform teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards, integration patterns, security requirements, and long-term platform health.
  • Use data, KPIs, adoption metrics, delivery metrics, and business feedback to identify improvement opportunities, communicate progress, and support investment decisions.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity and change, helping stakeholders evaluate tradeoffs across speed, cost, control, resiliency, compliance, user experience, and long-term scalability.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures
  • Perform other duties as required

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Five (5) of progressive experience in enterprise application delivery, technology product ownership, application operations, systems integration, modernization, or technology transformation.
  • Experience supporting Finance, ERP, EPM, accounting, procurement, reporting, treasury, tax, compliance, or other enterprise business systems preferred.
  • Experience leading system migrations, integrations, modernization programs, cloud/platform transitions, or application rationalization efforts.
  • Experience working in complex enterprise environments with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, systems integrators, and control/compliance partners.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application delivery, operational support, system integrations, data flows, controls, and technology lifecycle management.
  • Ability to translate business strategy and Finance capability needs into technology roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of Finance processes, financial systems, reporting, operational controls, data quality, audit requirements, and enterprise technology dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex initiatives across business, technology, vendor, and compliance stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach teams, create accountability, manage priorities, develop talent, and build trust during transformation and change.
  • Ability to manage vendor performance, systems integrator delivery, statements of work, third-party dependencies, risks, and issue resolution.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and tradeoff management capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear executive-level updates, roadmap materials, risk summaries, and decision recommendations.
  • Ability to operate with urgency and discipline in ambiguous, evolving, or high-dependency environments.
  • Strong orientation toward operational excellence, service reliability, simplification, automation, data quality, and measurable business value.
  • Familiarity with freight, transportation, logistics, or other operationally intensive industries preferred.

JOB CONDITIONS:

  • Some travel required
  • May require availability outside standard business hours to support critical releases, production incidents, transformation milestones, or business continuity.

Preferred Skills/ Knowledge

Finance Transformation & Technology Modernization Leadership -Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale technology transformation programs involving multiple workstreams, legacy platform retirement, cloud and SaaS adoption, and enterprise-wide modernization initiatives while ensuring alignment with business strategy and operational objectives. Executive Stakeholder Management & Strategic Influence -Proven experience partnering with executive leadership to drive decision-making, manage competing priorities, negotiate cross-functional trade-offs, and develop compelling executive-level presentations, communications, and governance materials. Platform Standardization & Business Process Optimization -Expertise in leading business transformation efforts focused on process harmonization, technology platform standardization, and organizational change management, balancing business needs with enterprise architecture and operational efficiency goals. Product Adoption, Requirements Governance & Value Realization -Strong ability to evaluate delivered product functionality against business requirements, facilitate discussions around configuration versus customization, and guide stakeholders toward adoption of standard capabilities to maximize scalability, maintainability, and long-term business value.

job.title: Sr Prod Owner-Mktg & Data Cloud
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for the strategy, backlog, and delivery outcomes for SFMC, Data Cloud identity resolution, and the attribution Hub that feeds all demand channels. Will oversee the intersection of deliverability, data quality, compliance, marketing effectiveness, and AI-powered content and campaign optimization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Maintain the Marketing Cloud (SFMC) backlog end-to-end, including campaign journeys, Content Builder assets, Cloud Pages lead capture, send management, deliverability operations, and AI-powered content optimization.

  • Serve as the authority for all demand channel attributions flowing through the Attribution Hub, defining channel-level KPIs, segment activation rules, and campaign performance metrics in partnership with Marketing leadership.

  • Define product requirements for identity resolution rules, ensuring deterministic match keys (email, account number).

  • Oversee IP warming strategy and deliverability operations in partnership with monitoring tools (Everest/Validity), including send volume ramp schedules, engagement-based list segmentation, and inbox placement tracking.

  • Oversee the Agentforce AI product strategy for Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud, including AI-generated content personalization, predictive send time optimization, AI-powered audience segmentation, and marketing agent deployment for campaign orchestration and lead nurturing.

  • Define AI content guardrails and governance policies: establish approval workflows for AI-generated marketing content, brand voice compliance checks, and Einstein Trust Layer configurations for marketing use cases.

  • Evaluate, select, and manage marketing technology vendor partners, including deliverability monitoring (Everest/Validity), list hygiene (BriteVerify), contact enrichment (ZoomInfo), and emerging AI marketing tools. Manage vendor contracts, escalation paths, and integration health.

  • Design and maintain Marketing Cloud Connect synchronization requirements between SFMC and Sales Cloud, including polling configurations, subscriber key alignment, and data extension architecture.

  • Author requirements for Cloud Pages lead capture forms using AMPscript patterns, ensuring web-to-lead flows comply with CAN-SPAM, state-level opt-in requirements, and privacy consent inheritance rules applicable to corporate separations.

  • Drive scored intake for all marketing technology feature requests, maintaining a prioritized backlog using BETS scoring with documented trade-off rationale.

  • Define activation targets that push segments to SFMC for campaign sends to Sales Cloud for seller alerts, and to advertising platforms for suppression or retargeting, with documented Manager boundaries per channel.

  • Coordinate with IT Security and the CISO office to ensure SFMC configurations meet DLP, encryption, and consent management requirements for a publicly traded company.

  • Oversee the ZoomInfo contact enrichment integration requirements for Marketing Cloud, including list hygiene rules, enrichment-to-send pipeline design, and exclusion logic during IP warming periods.

  • Oversee the Marketing Cloud separation from the legacy parent organization, including subscriber list migration, journey rebuild, Content Builder asset transfer, and sender profile reconfiguration for the new domain.

  • Design and track marketing performance dashboards: inbox placement rates (not just ISP acceptance), engagement rates, MQL pipeline contribution, attribution by channel, campaign ROI, and AI content performance metrics.

  • Manage SI partner (Accenture) and consultant delivery for Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud workstreams: review deliverables, approve story completion, and govern the transition from partner-led to FTE-Managed operations.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science or related field

  • Seven (7) years of Product Owner or product management experience with Marketing Cloud Engagement (ExactTarget/SFMC), including Journey Builder, Content Builder, Cloud Pages, and Automation Studio.

  • Demonstrated experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP), including identity resolution configuration, data model objects (DMOs), Calculated Insights, and segment activation to multiple channels.

  • Proven track record managing IP warming programs for new sending domains, including volume ramp planning, engagement list segmentation, ISP-specific throttling, and deliverability monitoring via Everest, Validity, or equivalent tools.

  • Experience with Agentforce, Einstein AI, or equivalent AI/ML capabilities for marketing automation, including AI content generation, predictive analytics, and intelligent segmentation.

  • Experience designing Marketing Cloud Connect (MCC) integrations with Sales Cloud, including subscriber key strategy, synchronized data extensions, and send logging architecture.

  • Strong understanding of email compliance frameworks: CAN-SPAM, GDPR consent models, state-level opt-in laws, and consent inheritance during corporate separations or rebrands.

  • Experience with B2B demand generation attribution models, including multi-touch attribution, first-touch/last-touch comparisons, and channel-level ROI reporting.

  • Ability to write AMPscript or SSJS for dynamic content personalization, lead capture, and data manipulation within SFMC.

  • Demonstrated experience managing marketing technology vendor ecosystems, including contract management, integration oversight, and vendor performance evaluation.

  • Experience managing SI partner or consultant delivery teams while maintaining internal product authority.

  • Salesforce certifications required: Marketing Cloud Email Specialist. Preferred: Marketing Cloud Consultant, Data Cloud Consultant.

job.title: Project Manager - ERP
job.description:
Project Manager - ERP

Chicago, IL

Background

Olam International Limited is a leading food and agri-business supplying food, ingredients, feed, and fibre to over 19,800 customers worldwide, ranging from multi-national organizations with world-famous brands to small family-run businesses. Olam’s value chain spans over 60 countries and includes farming, processing, and distribution operations, as well as a sourcing network of 4.8 million farmers. It is headquartered in Singapore and listed on the Singapore Stock Exchange.

The Board of Olam International Ltd, Singapore decided to reorganize Olam’s global businesses into separate companies to sharpen the focus on individual business categories:


  • Olam Holding (OH)

  • Olam Food Ingredients (ofi)

  • Olam Agri

The reorganization was carried out at the global level.

About ofi

ofi was carved out from Olam International Limited in 2020 and is scheduled to be listed on the UK stock exchange.

ofi is a global leader at the forefront of food & beverage consumer trends. Through its complementary portfolio of cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts, and spices, ofi delivers sustainable, natural, and plant-based ingredients & solutions to its global and diversified customer base. ofi's footprint includes 51 countries’ operations, 100+ manufacturing plants, 15 innovation centres supplying food and raw materials procured from 2.6 million farmers to over 8,000+ global customers worldwide.

ofi is driven by a strong purpose – ‘Be the change for good food and a healthy future’. By working with ofi, you’ll be helping to create a real impact on the ground. Sustainability is built into our business model - from our offices to our farming operations and supply chains, we’re acting across issues as diverse as farmer poverty, deforestation, and greenhouse gas emissions.

About the function: Information Technology

Given the carve-out and the new strategic journey, ofi is focussing on areas that accelerate growth through innovation strategy. Along these lines, the IT function is looking forward to driving the next wave of value creation that can have a tangible positive impact on the organization as well as our partners including farmers, suppliers, customers and communities.

About the Role: Project Manager - ERP

As part of its business transformation journey, ofi is implementing SAP S4HANA across all its operations. There are multiple large-sized to medium-sized SAP projects in the pipeline. Project Manager – ERP is responsible for overseeing the planning, execution and successful delivery of assigned SAP implementation projects. The primary purpose of this role is to ensure that the project is completed on time, within budget and meets the specified objectives. The ideal candidate will possess sound understanding of SAP ERP, good communication and leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing global SAP implementations.

Key responsibilities


  1. Develop and document detailed project plan including scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines and resource requirements.

  2. Identify and engage with key stakeholders, both internal and external, and garner their involvement and support throughout the project lifecycle.

  3. Monitor project progress, track milestones, and ensure adherence to project schedules. Resolve or escalate issues and conflicts that may arise during project execution.

  4. Manage project budgets, tracking expenses and ensuring efficient utilization of the resources. Allocate resources appropriately to meet project requirements.

  5. Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. Monitor and manage risks throughout the project lifecycle to either mitigate or minimize their impact on project success.

  6. Develop change management plans to facilitate smooth transition during SAP implementations. Communicate changes effectively to stakeholders and manage their expectations.

  7. Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, status reports and change requests. Provide regular project updates to stakeholders and senior management.

  8. Identify lessons learned from each project and implement improvements to project management methodologies and processes.

  9. Track project benefits, compare them against the initial objectives and deliverables and report them to stakeholders and senior management.

Qualifications & Skills


  1. Bachelors in information technology, computer science or a related field

  2. Certification in project management (PMP, Prince2, or equivalent). Strong understanding of project management methodologies, tools and best practices.

  3. Proven experience as a project manager for 5-8 years, preferably in food industry.

  4. Good understanding of SAP ERP, and functionalities of core SAP modules.

  5. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate and build relationship with stakeholders at all levels.

  6. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on delivering solutions to complex business challenges.

  7. Ability to work with global cross-functional teams.

  8. Ability and desire to travel up to 40% of the time with flexible working schedule (early start or delayed end) based on the global project requirements.

  9. Bilingual ability in English and Spanish and/or Portuguese will be a significant plus.

job.title: Ana-Sales Cloud & Core Platform
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for the day-to-day configuration, user support, and operational health of Sales Cloud and serves as the primary point of contact for seller-facing platform issues. Maintains core platform administration responsibilities shared across the six-cloud Salesforce org, including user lifecycle management, permission architecture, CI/CD pipeline support and sandbox environment management.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Oversee Sales Cloud configuration and ongoing administration: page layouts, record types, validation rules, formula fields, Flow automations, approval processes, and declarative customizations supporting Sales.

  • Administer Enterprise Territory Management (ETM) including territory hierarchy maintenance, assignment rule configuration, UserTerritory2Association management, and multi-tagging resolution for the GRAND/CAC/FAN account structure.

  • Oversee the full user lifecycle across the Salesforce org: provisioning, deactivation, role assignment, profile assignment, permission set group management, and license allocation tracking for all six clouds.

  • Implement and maintain the security model: Organization-Wide Defaults, Role Hierarchy, sharing rules (Manager-based and criteria-based), field-level security, and permission set architecture following the minimal-profile design pattern.

  • Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 production support for seller-facing issues: login problems, data visibility questions, report/dashboard troubleshooting, mobile experience issues, and Flow errors. Escalate Tier 3 issues to developers or architects.

  • Support the CI/CD pipeline (Copado for Salesforce clouds, GitHub Actions for MuleSoft/infrastructure): execute sandbox refreshes, validate deployment packages, manage change sets when required, and maintain environment documentation.

  • Administer Sales Cloud dashboards, reports, and list views aligned to pipeline coverage, win rate, forecast accuracy, and territory performance metrics.

  • Configure and maintain data quality controls: duplicate management rules, data import validation, mass update procedures, and record merge governance for the National account base.

  • Support MuleSoft integration health from the Salesforce side: monitor connected app configurations, Named Credential management, API usage dashboards, and integration user account maintenance for D365 and other system connections.

  • Administer Agentforce features within Sales Cloud as they are deployed: SDR Agent configuration support, Deal Agent settings, Sales Coach enablement, Einstein Activity Capture, and AI feature permission set assignment.

  • Execute Salesforce release readiness activities: review Salesforce seasonal release notes (Spring, Summer, Winter), assess impact on configurations, test in sandbox, and communicate changes to the Product team and sellers.

  • Maintain platform documentation including configuration inventory, admin runbook, permission matrix, and environment map. Keep documentation current with every configuration change.

  • Support UAT execution for Sales Cloud releases: configure test environments, create test users, reset test data, troubleshoot defects, and validate fixes before production deployment.

  • Partner with the Sales Cloud Product and Sales Operations team (Intake Sync) to implement approved configuration changes using the scored backlog intake process.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science or related field

  • Three (3) years of Salesforce administration experience with hands-on Sales Cloud configuration in an enterprise environment.

  • Demonstrated experience with Enterprise Territory Management including territory hierarchy design, assignment rules, and sharing model configuration.

  • Strong understanding of the Salesforce security model: Organization-Wide Defaults, Role Hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and field-level security.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow Builder for process automation, approval workflows, and record-triggered actions.

  • Experience with Salesforce data management: duplicate rules, import wizards, Data Loader, and mass update tools.

  • Ability to create and maintain reports, dashboards, and list views aligned to business KPIs.

  • Experience providing production support in a Salesforce environment, including issue triage, root cause analysis, and user communication.

  • Salesforce certifications required: Salesforce Administrator. Preferred: Advanced Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant.

  • Strong documentation skills and comfort maintaining admin runbooks, configuration inventories, and knowledge base articles.

  • Experience with Agentforce, Einstein AI features, or equivalent AI capabilities within Sales Cloud.

  • Familiarity with Copado or equivalent Salesforce-native CI/CD tooling.

  • Experience supporting MuleSoft or other middleware integrations from the Salesforce administration side (connected apps, Named Credentials, API monitoring).

  • LTL freight, logistics, or B2B sales operations experience.

  • Experience with complex account hierarchy models (parent/child/grandchild) at scale.

  • Background in sandbox management, environment strategy, and release management processes.

Work CONDITIONS:


  • Some travel required

job.title: Domain Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Lead the long range planning for the business, application, data and technical architecture for the solutions in a specific domain. Ensuring all solutions within that domain work logically and coherently together.

Essential Functions

Current State:

  • Document current state architecture, including data flows, integration points, and system interactions in anticipation of reimagination.
  • Work with development teams to diagnose and resolve complex, multi-system spanning production issues.

Future State Design & Execution:

  • Develop detailed roadmaps for the preferred future state of the technology & solutions architecture.
  • Identify gaps between current and future states and propose strategic solutions to bridge these gaps.
  • Work closely with business leaders, IT teams, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and understand business needs.
  • Analyze business requirements and develop functional/system specifications.
  • Facilitate workshops and discussions to align technology strategies with business architecture as well as data & information systems architecture.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and alignment of architectural solutions.

Architecture Design:

  • Create and maintain architectural models, including diagrams, flowcharts, and documentation to support proposed solutions.
  • Track, manage and define plans to mitigate technical debt and includes debt associated with individual applications, system integration, and other software engineering aspects.

Technology Evaluation:

  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends, tools, and technologies to drive continuous improvement.
  • Partner with the Technical Architecture organization on evaluation emerging technologies, tools, and platforms to recommend enhancements to the information systems architecture.

Mentoring and Leadership:

  • Guide and mentor junior developers, fostering a culture of learning and growth within the team
  • Lead cross-functional teams in architecture-related initiatives and projects.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Hands-on involvement in solving complex coding challenges and implementing efficient solutions.
  • Functional domain experience in one or more of the following: Clearance, Airline Operations, Shipment Operations, Sort Operations, Commercial/Digital Experience.
  • Knowledge of the organization's industry group, trends, directions, major issues, regulatory considerations, and trendsetters; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations
  • Experience working with and deploying systems which incorporate best practice principles, patterns, and tools
  • Collaboration skills and ability to work in a dynamic team environment and interact with global talent from technical and non-technical organizations
  • Strong understanding of business capability management strategies and solutions with hands-on experience architecting, designing, implementing, and delivering solutions
  • Ability to identify opportunities for reusable data services to reduce data duplication
  • Knowledge of and ability to design, apply and evaluate new information technologies for business environments to improve work productivity and accuracy.
  • Experience working with Business and IT Architects in architecture roadmaps and modeling tools (e.g., IRIS, Sparx, or other similar tools).
  • Knowledge of Business Architecture Guild (BIZBOK) and The Open Architecture Framework (TOGAF) or similar architectural frameworks.
  • Extreme Programming (XP) and/or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) experience and architecture practice experience
  • Proven initiative execution skills

Preferred Qualifications:

Lead the long-range planning and execution for the application and technical architecture for solutions in the Global Clearance & Brokerage domain. Ensuring all solutions within that domain work logically and coherently together.

A career in the Global Clearance organization will provide you with a unique opportunity to reimagine the preferred future state of the Global Clearance architecture and see the execution & actualization of core capabilities that will deliver market differentiation and bankable value for FedEx.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of information systems, architecture frameworks, sharp critical thinking skills, systems thinking mindset and a history of transitioning from legacy applications to modern-engineered software.

As the Domain Architect, you will be a key player in the development team, deeply engaged in all aspects of project execution. You will ensure your architectural vision is realized by collaborating with development teams and stakeholders. In this role, you will actively design, code, test, and optimize solutions until the product is successfully implemented in production.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information Systems, business and/or equivalent formal training or work experience.

Minimum Experience

Five (5) years work experience in information technology or engineering environment. A related advanced degree may offset the related experience requirement.

job.title: Sr. Platform Engineer II (Cloud Security)
job.description:
Sr. Platform Engineer II (Cloud Security)


Chicago

Disclaimer: Please be advised that the most accurate and up-to-date information about our open roles—including job descriptions, compensation, and benefits—can only be guaranteed on our official job board. For the latest listings and details, please visit: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/ninjatrader.

JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE #1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD

Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're on a mission to empower traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Over the last 20 years, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. In the last five years alone, our user base has grown by 400% to over 1.9 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

What you'll do:

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to define and drive our cloud and edge security strategy from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity to architect, implement, and evolve the security posture for our production infrastructure across GCP and Cloudflare. You’ll own security for the systems that underpin our trading infrastructure, mission-critical services that demand high performance, low latency, and 99.95%+ uptime.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in high-stakes environments, embraces DevSecOps principles, and understands the importance of security automation at scale. You’ll work closely with SREs, Platform Engineers, and the Security team to ensure we build secure systems by design.

You’ll be part of the Platform Engineering team, which owns the systems and infrastructure that power NinjaTrader’s trading platform. We run entirely in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and make extensive use of Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern CI/CD pipelines to enable secure and scalable software delivery. While NinjaTrader has a centralized Security team focused on IT, governance, and compliance, this role will focus exclusively on cloud and infrastructure security from within the engineering organization.

In this role you will:

  • Define and implement cloud and edge security architecture across GCP, Kubernetes, and Cloudflare.
  • Lead the creation and enforcement of IAM policies and role-based access controls across infrastructure and services.
  • Manage and configure Cloudflare settings including DNS zones, domains, WAF rules, bot protection, DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust policies.
  • Design and integrate DevSecOps practices into CI/CD pipelines to ensure secure-by-default software delivery.
  • Build tooling and workflows to support “security as code”—automating policies, monitoring, and controls via Terraform and other IaC tools.
  • Monitor cloud environments for misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and active threats using GCP-native and third-party tools.
  • Partner with the centralized Security team to align cloud initiatives with company-wide risk management and compliance goals.
  • Contribute to internal threat modeling, incident response planning, and postmortem analysis from a cloud perspective.
  • Champion secure engineering best practices across teams and provide mentorship on cloud security topics.

What you'll need:

  • 8+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and/or security engineering, with at least 3 years focused on GCP.
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing cloud security architecture in production environments.
  • Deep understanding of GCP services (IAM, VPC, GKE, SCC, Cloud Armor) and Kubernetes security.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cloudflare, including WAF, DNS, access control, and traffic management.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and other Infrastructure-as-Code tools, including automated security guardrails.
  • Experience integrating security into CI/CD workflows and developer pipelines (DevSecOps).
  • Scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) to support tooling and infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud threat models, vulnerability management, and secure system design is essential.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as Wiz, Security Command Center, or custom GCP monitoring solutions.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills; able to influence engineers and leadership across departments.
  • Bonus: Relevant certifications (e.g., GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, OSCP) or experience in low-latency, high-uptime environments such as trading or financial systems.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in the trading industry
  • Contributions to open-source projects

Compensation:

The salary range for this role will be $150,000.00 - $190,000.00 USD annually. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of up to 12%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).

Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. Additional details on our total compensation package and benefits are listed below.

Location:

This role is based in Chicago, IL. There may be remote flexibility for exceptional candidates in the following states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Washington D.C., Wisconsin, New Jersey, Pennsylvania.

Hybrid:

For Chicago-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:

  • 20 additional flex remote days annually
  • 5 Company Wide Office-Optional weeks tied to major holidays

Our Core Benefits Include:

  • Generous PTO
  • 7 Paid Holidays Annually + 5 Conditional Holidays Annually
  • 1 Service Day Annually
  • 401k with 3.5% Company Match
  • Paid Parental Bonding Leave
  • Health, Vision, Dental Coverage
  • Life and Disability Insurance Covered 100% by NinjaTrader

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

job.title: Client Success Specialist
job.description:
About The Role

Our Client Success Specialist serves as the primary point of contact for clients enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. They are Beyond’s caring voice to the client and guide them from enrollment through graduation. Our Client Success Specialist possesses a “second-to-none” work ethic and an upbeat, positive and passionate attitude about customer service. By responding promptly to client requests, and possessing an acute awareness that allows them to anticipate the client’s needs and exceed expectations, our Client Success Department is critical to the success of helping maintain Beyond’s white glove service standard..

As a Client Success Representative, you will complete a four week training program to become an expert in our financial hardship programs. After you successfully complete training, you will be responsible for providing superior customer service and a positive experience to our clients. The Client Success Specialist role is a remote position.

What You’ll Do

  • Above all else, provide a helpful and caring customer service experience over high volume inbound and outbound client phone calls of varying complexity by responding to client requests, anticipating unstated needs, and educating them on our programs in a remote call center environment
  • Proactively identify, analyze and resolve client issues by utilizing active listening and critical thinking to provide first call resolution with focus on the customer relationship
  • Occasionally handle emails/inquiries from clients regarding complex topics and issues requiring superb written and verbal communication skills
  • Exhibit strong written/verbal communication skills, excel at customer interaction, and deliver practical solutions
  • Develop and maintain positive client relations and work collaboratively with other departments within the company to ensure client requests and questions are appropriately handled in a timely manner
  • Work independently and with a team (indirectly) to drive retention of clients through bolstering product knowledge and providing best-in-class service at all times
  • Operate, navigate, and troubleshoot a desktop computer to obtain and extract information; research through multiple robust computer programs/systems simultaneously and document information, activities and changes in the CRM database (Client Relationship Management System) for client accounts. Apply various troubleshooting techniques to resolve complicated technical or configuration issues
  • Continuously learn, interpret and utilize company and industry knowledge, practices, and procedures to deliver accurate and up-to-date solutions.
  • Meet and exceed client centric performance expectations focused around quality of service and efficiency
  • Engage with feedback to leader and team to collaborate and streamline workflows

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferred
  • Bilingual - Spanish (preferred / not required)
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn and navigate complex systems
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and listening)
  • You operate with understanding, active listening, patience, empathy and kindness to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills and can independently handle routine and complex client inquiries
  • Have a people-focused approach and solution mindset, you’re an effective problem solver.
  • Effective at time management, planning & organizing tasks
  • Ability to work from home in a distraction free environment
  • Reliable, High Speed, Internet connection

job.title: AI Engineer Lead
job.description:
The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that support intelligent automation, predictive insight, and advanced analytics across the enterprise. As a hands-on builder, this role applies software engineering principles to write production-quality code, build scalable AI systems, including AI Agents and data pipelines, and integrate AI models into new and existing business applications.

The AI Engineer collaborates closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, ML Ops Engineers, and Platform teams to bring machine learning models from prototype to production. A critical part of this function is to ensure that AI use cases are transitioned from experimentation into reliable, governed, and business-ready solutions by owning their complete operational readiness. This includes implementing robust observability, defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and establishing clear incident response and rollback strategies for all AI services.

About the Role -

Enabling the "One FedEx" Ontology for Unified Network Design (N2.0)

To fully realize the Network 2.0 (N2.0) vision, FedEx requires a unified data and operational model that breaks down historical silos. This AI Principal Lead is the technical engine behind the Neptune Ontology, building the complex AI structures and knowledge graphs necessary for a true "One FedEx" Ontology. By engineering scalable AI and data pipelines that seamlessly integrate Surface and Air Design, this role enables leadership to model, simulate, and optimize the entire enterprise network as a single, cohesive ecosystem rather than disparate operating companies.

Optimizing the Tri-Color Strategy via Advanced Demand and Execution AI

Executing the Tri-Color network strategy requires unprecedented precision in forecasting and routing. This role brings advanced machine learning, predictive analytics, and LLM-driven AI Agents to the forefront of Network Planning. By developing intelligent algorithms that deeply understand Demand patterns, this lead ensures we can dynamically allocate volume to the right network layer (Purple, Orange, or White) at the right time. Furthermore, by integrating these AI models directly into operational applications, they drive automated, intelligent Execution outcomes—optimizing load planning, reducing empty miles, and maximizing yield across all transportation modes.

Ensuring Mission-Critical Reliability for N2.0 Operations

As AI transitions from experimental to operational, the systems driving N2.0 must be as reliable as our physical fleet. This Principal Lead does not just build models; they engineer the rigorous MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, and observability frameworks required to keep the Neptune Ecosystem running seamlessly. By establishing strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for latency, monitoring for data drift, and ensuring robust governance, this role guarantees that the AI powering our real-time Surface and Air execution is trusted, secure, and fully capable of operating at FedEx's global scale.

Essential Functions

  • Hands-On Model & Graph Development: Write clean, efficient, and well-documented production-quality code to engineer scalable AI systems, knowledge graphs, and complex data pipelines.
  • Domain-Driven AI Architecture: Develop intelligent, LLM-driven AI Agents and advanced algorithms that possess a deep understanding of enterprise demand patterns and transportation networks.
  • MLOps & Enterprise Reliability: Design and maintain scalable ML pipelines for model training, validation, inference, and deployment. Partner with MLOps teams using established CI/CD practices to manage live deployment.
  • Mission-Critical Governance: Own end-to-end operational readiness by establishing strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for system latency and availability. Implement robust observability frameworks to monitor for data drift, error rates, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Engineering: Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Domain Architects to transition experimental models out of research phases into stable, secure, and business-ready production solutions.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Essential Logistics Domain Acumen: Prior experience translating complex operational, supply chain, freight routing, or transportation workflows into software models. The candidate must demonstrate the ability to quickly master FedEx's physical footprint to optimize integrated Surface and Air execution.
  • Production AI Engineering Depth: Proven track record as a hands-on software engineer specializing in scaling AI systems, RAG frameworks, and complex data pipelines into real-world production environments.
  • Graph & Data Architecture: Extensive experience working with graph structures, ontologies, and data mapping tools designed to harmonize historically siloed or disparate data ecosystems.
  • MLOps Infrastructure Fluency: Direct experience building automated CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), and managing model lifecycles under strict corporate uptime and latency SLAs.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Strong capability to interface with research-focused Data Scientists and structural Domain Architects, acting as the engineering execution arm that makes their frameworks operational.

Minimum Education:

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field highly preferred.

Minimum Experience:

5+ years of technical experience where they have a proven track record of architecting and building large-scale, novel AI systems

Domicile Information

The preferred locations for this position are Remote or Hybrid (Memphis TN or Pittsburgh PA.) However, we will consider candidates based elsewhere within the United States (excluding Alaska, Hawaii, and U.S. territories).

Candidates residing within 50 miles of a FedEx campus will be required to work on-site at a FedEx location several times per week.

job.title: Sr Product Owner-Sales Cloud
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for translating commercial strategy into platform capabilities while managing scope, adoption, and delivery quality. Position will drive sales outcomes: seller productivity, pipeline accuracy, territory data integrity, and platform adoption.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Maintain the Sales Cloud product backlog for sellers across territories, translating commercial strategy into prioritized user stories with measurable acceptance criteria.

  • Drive scored intake and prioritization for all Sales Cloud feature requests, partnering with Sales Operations through a structured Intake Sync to maintain a single, transparent demand funnel.

  • Define and enforce product requirements for Enterprise Territory Management (ETM), including configurations, territory hierarchy rules, and multi-tagging resolution.

  • Partner with Data Cloud and MuleSoft teams to design activation targets that surface Calculated Insights (churn risk, shipment velocity, analysis) directly into seller workflows via record-triggered actions and alerts.

  • Oversee the Agentforce AI strategy for Sales Cloud, including SDR Agent deployment (24/7 lead engagement, personalized outreach, meeting booking), Deal Agent configuration (auto-update opportunity stages based on email/calendar activity), and Sales Coach Agent enablement (deal-specific feedback, AI role-play, objection handling).

  • Define AI agent acceptance criteria, testing protocols, and performance metrics. Partner with the Agentforce Testing Center to validate agent responses, monitor hallucination rates, and optimize agent grounding using CRM data, Knowledge articles, and Data Cloud unified profiles.

  • Evaluate, select, and manage AI and automation vendor partners for Sales Cloud capabilities, including Agentforce licensing optimization (Flex Credits vs. per-user), third-party AI enrichment tools, and sales engagement platforms. Oversee vendor escalation and contract compliance.

  • Optimize the seller adoption strategy: define login frequency targets, record update baselines, pipeline activity thresholds, feature utilization benchmarks, and AI agent adoption rates.

  • Collaborate with the ERP integration team to define quote-to-close requirements, ensuring pricing workflows between MuleSoft and Sales Cloud support rate structures, contract pricing, and discounting approval chains.

  • Lead UAT planning, execution, and go/no-go readiness criteria for Sales Cloud releases, coordinating with QA governance partners and the SI delivery team.

  • Maintain Sales Cloud dashboards aligned to pipeline coverage, win rate, forecast accuracy, and Agentforce agent performance (meetings booked, leads engaged, deal recommendations accepted).

  • Author requirement documents for Sales Workspace, mobile experience, embedded coaching features, and AI-assisted selling capabilities that reduce seller friction and time-to-insight.

  • Oversee scope trade-offs against fixed deadlines using scoring (Business impact, Effort, Tech debt, Stakeholder urgency), documenting all deferral decisions with rationale in a decision log.

  • Coordinate with Salesforce Shield and IT Security to ensure Sales Cloud configurations meet encryption, field-level security, and event monitoring requirements appropriate for a publicly traded company.

  • Oversee SI partner delivery accountability for Sales Cloud workstreams: review sprint deliverables against acceptance criteria, approve story completion, escalate velocity or quality issues, and govern the transition from SI-led to FTE-Managed operations.

  • Facilitate sprint ceremonies (planning, review, retrospective) for Sales Cloud workstreams, maintaining velocity transparency and impediment resolution with the SI partner team.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science or related field

  • Seven (7) years of Product Owner or Product Management experience in enterprise Salesforce Sales Cloud implementations.

  • Demonstrated experience managing Enterprise Territory Management (ETM) at scale, including territory hierarchy design, assignment rules, and sharing model configuration.

  • Proven track record Managing a product backlog with 100+ user stories, applying structured prioritization frameworks (RICE or equivalent) with documented scoring.

  • Experience with Agentforce, Einstein AI, or equivalent AI/ML-powered sales tools, including agent configuration, AI testing methodologies, and performance metric definition.

  • Experience integrating Salesforce Data Cloud with Sales Cloud, including activation targets, segment-based alerts, and Calculated Insights surfaced in CRM workflows.

  • Strong understanding of quote-to-close processes, including CPQ or custom pricing integrations with ERP systems (D365, SAP, or Oracle).

  • Experience defining and tracking CRM adoption metrics: login rates, record creation/update velocity, pipeline hygiene, forecast accuracy, and AI feature utilization.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Shield (Platform Encryption, Event Monitoring, Field Audit Trail) in regulated or publicly traded company environments.

  • Demonstrated experience managing SI partner delivery teams (Accenture, Deloitte, or equivalent) and third-party vendor relationships while maintaining internal product authority.

  • Ability to write clear, testable acceptance criteria and facilitate UAT with cross-functional business stakeholders.

  • Experience deploying Agentforce SDR Agent, Deal Agent, or Sales Coach Agent in production environments.

  • LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) or freight/logistics industry experience.

  • Familiarity with MuleSoft API-led connectivity patterns and system-of-record boundary design.

  • Experience with Copado or equivalent Salesforce-native CI/CD tooling for release management.

  • Background in B2B sales process design, including complex account hierarchies and multi-tiered pricing.

  • MBA or equivalent business acumen demonstrated through product strategy documentation and executive communication.

  • Experience with Agentforce pricing model optimization (Flex Credits, per-conversation, per-user) and AI vendor evaluation.

Work CONDITIONS:


  • Some travel required

job.title: Advisor-Data Engineer MDM
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW
Advisor Data Engineer (MDM)
Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities utilizing modern cloud-based data platforms. Provide leadership and mentorship to MDM team while partnering with business, data, and technology stakeholders to establish trusted, governed master data products that support enterprise-wide analytics, operational processes, and strategic transformation initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Design and implement entity models, hierarchies, matching rules, survivorship strategies, stewardship workflows, and governance processes to ensure trusted master data assets.
Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion, synchronization, publishing, and distribution pipelines across enterprise source and target systems.
Architect and implement API-driven, event-based, and real-time integration solutions utilizing cloud-native technologies and enterprise integration patterns.
Establish development standards, best practices, DevOps processes, and operational procedures supporting MDM platform reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineers, developers, and administrators responsible for data management and integration solutions.
Collaborate with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, product teams, and data governance organizations to align master data capabilities with strategic business objectives.
Design and oversee integration architectures supporting Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, operational applications, data products, and analytics platforms.
Develop reusable frameworks and patterns for data onboarding, data sharing, data stewardship, data quality management, and master data syndication.
Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements related to master data assets.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase data accuracy, consistency, usability, and operational efficiency across the enterprise.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices related to MDM, data governance, data quality, and cloud data platforms.
Perform other duties as required.

QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
Five (5) or more years of progressively responsible experience designing and implementing enterprise data management, integration, and analytics solutions.
Three (3) or more years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Master Data Management platforms.
Demonstrated expertise designing matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, stewardship, and governance workflows in an enterprise MDM environment.
Strong experience developing cloud-native data solutions within Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, Databricks, or comparable modern data platforms.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, Java, JSON, Spring, Python, and PySpark development.
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging frameworks, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong understanding of data modeling principles including conceptual, logical, and physical data design.
Experience establishing CI/CD pipelines, version control practices, and automated deployment frameworks using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent technologies.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, provide architectural guidance, mentor engineers, and establish engineering standards.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience developing and operating enterprise-grade data quality, governance, and data stewardship programs.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to business and executive audiences.

WORKING CONDITIONS
Ability to work in a hybrid environment.
Must be able to travel as required to support business and project initiatives.

PREFERRED SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE

  1. Deep expertise with MDM platform architecture, configuration, administration, and operational support.
  2. Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Master Data Management operating models, governance frameworks, and data product strategies.
  3. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, Databricks, Delta Lake, Lakehouse architecture, and modern data platform ecosystems.
  4. Understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, enterprise integration frameworks, APIs, messaging technologies, and real-time data synchronization patterns.
  5. Experience implementing domain-driven MDM architectures supporting Customer, Shipment, Contact, Location, and Reference Data domains.
  6. Knowledge of enterprise data governance disciplines including metadata management, data lineage, business glossary, data ownership, and stewardship practices.
