job.title: Principal Engineer (Trading Systems)
job.description:
Principal Engineer (Trading Systems)
Chicago or Remote
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Principal Engineer to join our Trading Services
team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, evolving, and optimizing our core
trading infrastructure. You will help scale and enhance our highly scalable, low-latency trading system,
ensuring that it meets the highest standards of performance, scalability, and reliability. Your work will
directly impact our ability to support rapid growth in the retail futures trading space.

In this role, you will:
• Design, develop, and optimize our Scala based trading services for high-volume, low-latency,
24x7 environments.
• Lead architectural strategy for future-state scalability and performance optimization.
• Mentor and guide junior engineers, promoting best practices and technical excellence.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, operations, and security teams to
translate business requirements into robust and secure technical solutions.
• Optimize system performance, with focus on JVM tuning for Scala/Akka based distributed
system.
• Enhance monitoring and observability of services for real-time trade execution and
operational transparency.
• Ensure compliance with security policies, regulatory standards, and industry best practices.
Key Position Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent
experience).
• Extensive experience with high-performance, high-concurrency distributed trading systems.
• Proven expertise in JVM and performance tuning for high-performance environments.
• Experience supporting 24/7 production systems, ideally in trading environments.
• Deep knowledge of networking, and protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets, DNS, TCP/IP).
• Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
• Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills in high-pressure, real-time conditions.
• Excellent communication skills, capable of clearly articulating technical concepts to diverse
stakeholders.
• Experience in Java/Scala/Rust/C++ or functional programming languages within
exchange/trading environments.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in low-latency, lock-free development and design.
• Strong experience with multithreading and concurrency in high-performance environments.

• Familiarity with binary or custom trading protocols.
• Strong knowledge of messaging frameworks (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and network protocols (UDP,
TCP).
• Hands-on experience implementing HTTP/WebSockets, REST APIs, OAuth, gRPC, and Redis
APIs.
• Deep understanding of order handling/matching engines.
• Extensive experience with FIX or other market data/order-entry protocols.
• Practical hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes and Docker).
• Solid grasp of network communications,

job.title: Sr Product Owner-Slack Plt/Coffab
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Responsible for the strategy, backlog, and delivery outcomes for SFMC, Data Cloud identity resolution, and the attribution Hub that feeds all demand channels. Will oversee the intersection of deliverability, data quality, compliance, marketing effectiveness, and AI-powered content and campaign optimization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Deliver the Slack platform strategy and phased rollout using a Crawl/Walk/Run framework.

  • Define and prioritize Slack workflow automations for commercial teams, translating seller and marketer pain points into Workflow Builder configurations, channel strategies, and notification designs that reduce context-switching and information fragmentation.

  • Design Salesforce-to-Slack integration requirements, including real-time CRM notifications (deal stage changes, territory alerts, case escalations), account collaboration channels, and Data Cloud-triggered alerts surfaced in Slack.

  • Oversee the Agentforce AI product strategy for Slack, including SDR Agent deployment (lead engagement via Slack), Sales Coach Agent enablement (deal-specific feedback in channel), Service Agent routing (autonomous case resolution), Customer Insights Agent configuration (360-degree briefings from Data Cloud), Employee Help Agent (internal IT/HR support), and the custom Driver Lead Agent (driver-to-pipeline conversion).

  • Define AI agent acceptance criteria, deployment protocols, and ongoing performance metrics for all Agentforce agents in Slack. Manage agent testing using the Agentforce Testing Center, monitor hallucination rates, and configure escalation thresholds.

  • Evaluate, select, and manage Slack ecosystem vendor partners, including app integrations (Tableau, Zoom, task management), telephony connectors, and Agentforce licensing. Oversee vendor security reviews using scoring with documented business cases required before each deployment.

  • Run the Slack channel governance model: naming conventions, channel lifecycle policies, archival rules, permission structures, and compliance-grade retention settings appropriate for a publicly traded company.

  • Drive adoption strategy for sellers and commercial team members, defining onboarding flows, power-user enablement programs, and engagement metrics (DAU/MAU, workflow trigger rates, channel activity by team, AI agent utilization rates).

  • Coordinate with IT/IAM on Slack SSO (Okta SAML 2.0), DLP policy enforcement within Slack Enterprise Grid, eDiscovery/legal hold configurations, and data residency compliance.

  • Manage the legacy connection sunset and transition plan, ensuring sellers retain deal notification functionality without service interruption during platform changeover.

  • Partner with Data Cloud and Sales Cloud Product Owners to design cross-platform activation flows: Data Cloud insight triggers Slack notification, seller takes action in Sales Cloud, outcome logged back to Data Cloud for attribution.

  • Define and track Slack platform health metrics the framework: Adoption (license utilization, active workspace ratio, workflow adoption rate, AI agent engagement), Integrity (channel hygiene, bot/integration reliability, SSO compliance), Metrics (time-to-response for deal alerts, workflow completion rates, seller satisfaction, agent resolution accuracy).

  • Oversee the Slackbot product strategy: define use cases for meeting prep, canvas generation, enterprise search, thread summarization, and agent orchestration capabilities included with Business+ licenses.

  • Oversee SI partner and consultant delivery for Slack integration workstreams: review deliverables, approve story completion, and govern the transition from partner-led to FTE-Managed operations.

  • Enforce phase gates to prevent scope creep: no custom Slack app development, no unapproved third-party apps, and all features require a scored business case before entering the backlog.

  • Evaluate Honeywell CT47 driver device capabilities and constraints for Slack mobile deployment, ensuring driver-sourced lead workflows function on the confirmed hardware platform.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science or related field

  • Seven (7) years of Product Management experience with at least 3 years managing an enterprise Slack or collaboration platform deployment.

  • Demonstrated experience designing Salesforce-to-Slack integrations, including CRM notification architecture, channel automation, and Workflow Builder implementations.

  • Proven track record in enterprise Slack governance: channel naming standards, permission models, retention policies, and compliance configurations for regulated or publicly traded environments.

  • Experience with Agentforce, conversational AI agents, or equivalent AI chatbot/agent platforms deployed within collaboration tools, including agent configuration, testing, and performance monitoring.

  • Experience with Slack Enterprise Grid administration, including Okta SSO integration, DLP policy configuration, eDiscovery workflows, and audit log monitoring.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud and how activation targets can trigger Slack notifications (churn alerts, territory changes, engagement signals) in real time.

  • Experience defining and tracking collaboration platform adoption metrics: DAU/MAU ratios, workflow trigger rates, notification response times, AI agent utilization, and user satisfaction benchmarks.

  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor ecosystems for collaboration platforms, including app evaluation, security review processes, contract oversight, and vendor performance management.

  • Ability to design phased rollout strategies (Crawl/Walk/Run or equivalent) with clear scope boundaries, phase-gate criteria, and documented deferral rationale.

  • Experience managing platform migrations or vendor sunsets with user communication plans and zero-disruption fallback strategies.

  • Salesforce certifications preferred: Slack Certified Admin, Slack Certified Consultant.

  • Experience deploying Agentforce agents (SDR Agent, Sales Coach, Service Agent, or custom agents) within Slack-in production environments.

  • Familiarity with Tableau embedded analytics within Slack for pipeline visibility or operational dashboards.

  • LTL freight, logistics, or supply chain industry experience.

  • Experience leading enterprise collaboration tool adoption programs at scale.

  • Background in API-first platform design, including webhook architecture, event-driven notifications, and middleware integration patterns.

  • Experience with Agentforce pricing model optimization (Flex Credits vs. per-user) and AI vendor evaluation for collaboration use cases.

  • Experience with mobile device management constraints for field worker collaboration tools.

Work CONDITIONS:


  • Some travel required

job.title: Sr Adv-Sales & Mktg Cloud
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Serves as the administrative bridge between the Product team and IT Security, ensuring platform integrity across all six clouds while driving AI readiness and vendor partner management.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Manage all Marketing Cloud (SFMC) administration including Journey Builder configuration, Automation Studio job management, Content Builder governance, send classification and delivery profile maintenance, IP warming execution support, and SAP/sender authentication.

  • Administer Data environments including data stream monitoring, identity resolution rule health checks, segment activation troubleshooting, ingestion pipeline alerts, and Calculated Insight refresh schedules across the shipment record architecture.

  • Serve as the platform-wide Salesforce Shield administrator: configure and maintain Platform Encryption (field-level and deterministic), Event Monitoring dashboards and SIEM routing, and Field Audit Trail retention policies across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Data Cloud.

  • Manage DLP policy configuration and enforcement in partnership with the CISO, including Transaction Security Policies, session management rules, data classification labels, and third-party DLP vendor integration (Nightfall AI, Strac, or equivalent).

  • Manage Marketing Cloud Connect (MCC) synchronization between SFMC and Sales Cloud, including subscriber key alignment, synchronized data extension architecture, polling configuration, and send logging integrity.

  • Administer Attribution Hub operational health: monitor all demand channel data flows through Data Cloud, troubleshoot activation target failures, and maintain channel-level segment definitions in partnership with Marketing Cloud Product.

  • Configure and maintain Cloud Pages environments, AMPscript-based lead capture forms, web-to-lead flows, and CAN-SPAM/state-level opt-in consent management configurations.

  • Lead cross-cloud security audits: quarterly Health Check reviews, permission set hygiene, login anomaly investigation, API usage monitoring, and compliance readiness documentation for SOC 2, CCPA, and public company requirements.

  • Manage vendor partner relationships and contracts for deliverability monitoring (Everest/Validity), list hygiene (BriteVerify), contact enrichment (ZoomInfo), and DLP enforcement tools. Serve as the primary technical contact for vendor escalations and integration health.

  • Configure and govern Agentforce AI capabilities within Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud, including marketing agent configurations, AI-generated content guardrails, Einstein Trust Layer settings, and prompt template administration.

  • Author and maintain platform security documentation including encryption key management procedures (BYOK or EKM via Azure Key Vault), incident response playbooks for data exposure events, and Shield coverage gap matrices across all six clouds.

  • Mentor and provide technical oversight to Level 3 and Level 4 Administrators. Establish configuration standards, change management procedures, and administrative governance practices for the entire admin team.

  • Manage environment management strategy for Marketing Cloud and Data sandboxes, coordinate refresh schedules with the CI/CD pipeline (Copado/GitHub) and maintain environment parity documentation.

  • Support and monitor integrations between Salesforce and key Commercial/Operational systems including quoting/pricing engines, customer portals, identity systems, and data platforms: troubleshoot data flow or sync issues.

  • Support UAT execution for Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud releases, including test environment configuration, send domain verification, and deliverability validation in pre-production environments.

  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, computer science or related field

  • Seven (7) years of Salesforce administration experience with at least 3 years administering Marketing Cloud Engagement (SFMC), including Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, and Cloud Pages.

  • Demonstrated experience administering Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP), including data stream configuration, identity resolution monitoring, segment activation troubleshooting, and Calculated Insight management.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Shield administration: Platform Encryption configuration, Event Monitoring dashboard creation, Field Audit Trail policy management, and Transaction Security Policy implementation.

job.title: Sr ICT Analyst
job.description:
Senior Technical Support Analyst

at Brunswick Group (View all jobs)
New York, New York, United States

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a strategic advisory firm focused on critical issues. Our purpose is to help the great value-creating organizations of the world play a more successful role in society.

We advise on critical issues at the center of business, politics and society, and help our clients – the leaders of large, complex organizations – understand and navigate these interconnected worlds.

Brunswick is one firm globally, operating as a single profit center. This allows us to respond seamlessly and effectively to clients’ needs wherever they are in the world.

Founded in London in 1987, Brunswick’s global partnership has grown organically to 27 offices in 18 countries. We began as a M&A and financial communications firm and, over time, expanded our capabilities to provide expert advice to our clients on a range of business critical issues. We invested in new offices, sector teams and practice groups including investor engagement; shareholder activism; governance; regulatory and public affairs, including geopolitical; crisis; litigation; social issues including climate change and diversity, equity and inclusion; cybersecurity, data and privacy; employee engagement; digital communications; opinion research and analysis, and; creative services.

Our CEO is Neal Wolin, based in Washington, D.C. Our Chairman is Sir Alan Parker, based in London.

Maintaining and strengthening a diverse workforce and inclusive workplace are pillars of Brunswick’s culture and key to our future success. Valuing and supporting every colleague as an individual while helping them reach their full potential is critical to attracting and developing our greatest strength – our people. By embracing our differences and diverse perspectives we create richer experiences within our firm and enhance the quality of the ideas and advice that we deliver to our clients.

The Americas

In the U.S., we have offices in Chicago, Dallas, New York, San Francisco and Washington, D.C. In Brazil, we have an office in Sao Paulo. We advise clients on, among other things, domestic and cross border M&A, IPOs, activism, capital markets and investor relations, public and regulatory affairs, geopolitical issues, litigation, crisis, cyber, employee engagement, digital, opinion research and on broader reputation campaigns.

Colleagues in the U.S. are drawn from a variety of backgrounds and consist of in-depth industry and sector experts from banking, law, accounting, politics, government, journalism and the media, consulting and elsewhere. Our U.S. CEO is Nik Deogun.

For more information on Brunswick, including our offices and client offers, please visit our website: www.brunswickgroup.com

The Opportunity

Senior Technical Support Analyst

We are seeking a New York based Senior Technical Support Analyst to provide onsite face to face desktop support locally within this fast growing office. This person will participate in the wider global ICT team that supports all Brunswick offices around the world with telephone and remote desktop support.

This position requires some “on-call” coverage and occasional work beyond normal business hours due to the 24/7 rotation. This time and all approved overtime will be compensated in accordance with overtime regulations.

Knowledge, skills and experience:

  • Technical experience in administering, supporting, and deploying Windows 10 and macOS
  • O365 and Active Directory administration
  • O365 application support including full Microsoft Office suite
  • Ability to support and troubleshoot OS and application performance issues
  • Ability to provide network support with knowledge of protocols and services, such as TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP
  • Experience of supporting Apple devices such as iPhones and iPads with corporate MDM’s
  • Experience in using Microsoft Intune to support Windows devices
  • Basic experience in administering Microsoft Server OS’s
  • Experience supporting Zoom and Teams on client and room-based systems including presentations
  • Client Virtual Private Networks (VPN)
  • Knowledge and understanding of multi-factor authentication
  • Building Windows computers via Auto-Pilot method
  • Building of MacBook computers using JAMF
  • Supporting printer and photocopiers
  • ITIL knowledge is preferable as is an understanding of Cloud computing concepts

Other Qualities:

  • Customer focused and service orientated
  • Strong communication skills with both verbal and written
  • Excellent client service, time management and organized
  • A strong passion for technology and maintaining up to date knowledge
  • Motivated and enthusiastic; flexible self-starter
  • A team player
  • Able to listen, be adaptable and apply good problem-solving skills to requests
  • Demonstrates a high level of attention to detail
  • Calm and confident under pressure

Compensation & Benefits

The applicant who is selected for this position will be eligible for the following compensation and benefits:

In New York City, the range of base compensation will be: $120,000 - $140,000.

If an offer is extended to an applicant in New York City, the applicant will be paid in line with this range and based on the applicant’s experience and qualifications. This range applies only to the New York City position, and salaries in other offices and regions will vary based on an applicant’s experience and qualifications, as well as the competitive landscape.

Bonus Eligibility: Annual discretionary bonus contingent upon individual performance and the overall performance of the Firm.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. Disability insurance. Employee assistance program. Flexible spending account. Health savings account. Life insurance. Paid Time Off: Vacation and sick leave, as well as paid Bank Holidays. Firm-sponsored 401K Plan with 3% safe harbor contribution of base and bonus – immediate vesting.

Other: Career training and development opportunities and employee discounts.

job.description:
Job Title: Senior Manager, IT

Location: Chicago, IL

Department: IT
FLSA Status: Exempt

We are a global leader in food & beverage ingredients. Pioneers at heart, we operate at the forefront of consumer trends to provide food & beverage manufacturers with products and ingredients that will delight their consumers. Making a positive impact on people and planet is all part of the delight. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable and transparent supply. Supplying products and ingredients at scale is just the start. We add value through our unique, complementary portfolio of natural, delicious and nutritious products. With our fresh thinking, we help our customers unleash the sensory and functional attributes of cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices so they can create naturally good food & beverage products that meet consumer expectations. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Senior Director of Information Technology (IT), the Senior Manager, IT Infrastructure will provide guidance on infrastructure solutions, architectures, and support for business processes; work closely with other IT Teams in assessing, planning, and implementing infrastructure solutions and ensure the IT infrastructure is available and secure.

The ideal candidate should possess strong communication, IT Technical, planning, process improvement, and strategic decision-making skills. A proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment will be required for success in this position.

Position Responsibilities


  • Providing guidance on infrastructure solutions, architectures, and support for business processes.

  • Managing daily operations of core infrastructure and platforms including, but not limited to, data and voice networks, firewalls, Zscaler etc.

  • Working closely with the IT Security department to manage network vulnerabilities, software updates and patches.

  • Participating in and leading IT projects, and where applicable, ensure these are delivered within scope, budget, and adhere to company governance processes.

  • Maintaining and developing standards, technical documentation for the network infrastructure and for complex technical solutions.

  • Work with managed service provider to provide day to day operational support and continuous improvement.

  • Working to increase user satisfaction by monitoring critical IT systems and ensuring timely response and fix times.

  • Proactively researching new and more efficient technology and vendors in the pursuit of stability and reduction of expenses.

  • Working with IT Leadership in the budgeting process. Managing expenses and projects within approved budget guidelines.

  • Ensuring IT systems including servers, routers, firewalls, and switches, are patched in a timely manner.

  • Facilitating routine meetings to discuss strategic goals and progress; and

  • Communicating within the IT teams and across departments to ensure success.

Position Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Business Administration, or relevant educational or professional experience required.

  • Eight (8) years’ experience as a process manager level, including four years’ experience in a large, diverse global enterprise with a proven track record of leadership in Information Technology.

  • Minimum of two (2) years’ enterprise information security architecture and information security system design experience.

  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in implementing and supporting IT networks and IT solutions in fast-paced food processing environments.

  • Experience working with cloud services like Azure, AWS etc. to implement network services and perform integrations.

  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP and Ethernet networks (e.g. VLANs, VPN, VoIP, LAN/WAN), and network devices such as switches, routers, and wireless access points.

  • Experience with DNS, DHCP, Terminal Services, File Servers, Print Management, Group Policy and network routing protocols.

  • Experience with Gigabit Passive Optical networks.

  • Experience with security technologies such as firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate etc.), intrusion detection and intrusion prevention systems.

  • Experience implementing and supporting Zscaler solutions like ZIA, ZPA and NGFW.

  • Experience working with MPLS and SDWAN technologies, Site-to-Site and VPN technologies.

  • Knowledge of virtualization technologies, such as VMware and Nutanix.

  • Experience providing IT solutions in the Food or Agriculture Industry is strongly preferred.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presentation skills, are required. Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills are required.

  • Excellent resource planning and task scheduling skills are required.

  • Ability and desire to travel, as required, by the business.

job.title: Sr. Advisor, Data Engineer MDM
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW
Sr Advisor Data Engineer (MDM)
Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities utilizing modern cloud-based data platforms. Serve as the technical leader responsible for MDM architecture, data quality, integration frameworks, governance enablement, and operational excellence. Provide leadership and mentorship to MDM team while partnering with business, data, and technology stakeholders to establish trusted, governed master data products that support enterprise-wide analytics, operational processes, and strategic transformation initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead the architecture, design, configuration, and implementation of Master Data Management solutions across multiple business domains.
Design and implement entity models, hierarchies, matching rules, survivorship strategies, stewardship workflows, and governance processes to ensure trusted master data assets.
Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion, synchronization, publishing, and distribution pipelines across enterprise source and target systems.
Architect and implement API-driven, event-based, and real-time integration solutions utilizing cloud-native technologies and enterprise integration patterns.
Lead enterprise data quality initiatives, including data profiling, rules implementation, monitoring, exception management, and remediation workflows.
Establish development standards, best practices, DevOps processes, and operational procedures supporting MDM platform reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineers, developers, and administrators responsible for data management and integration solutions.
Own the technical roadmap, platform strategy, and lifecycle management of enterprise MDM capabilities.
Collaborate with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, product teams, and data governance organizations to align master data capabilities with strategic business objectives.
Design and oversee integration architectures supporting Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, operational applications, data products, and analytics platforms.
Develop reusable frameworks and patterns for data onboarding, data sharing, data stewardship, data quality management, and master data syndication.
Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements related to master data assets.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase data accuracy, consistency, usability, and operational efficiency across the enterprise.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices related to MDM, data governance, data quality, and cloud data platforms.
Perform other duties as required.

QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
Eight (8) or more years of progressively responsible experience designing and implementing enterprise data management, integration, and analytics solutions.
Five (5) or more years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Master Data Management platforms.
Demonstrated expertise designing matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, stewardship, and governance workflows in an enterprise MDM environment.
Strong experience developing cloud-native data solutions within Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, Databricks, or comparable modern data platforms.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, Java, JSON, Spring, Python, and PySpark development.
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging frameworks, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong understanding of data modeling principles including conceptual, logical, and physical data design.
Experience establishing CI/CD pipelines, version control practices, and automated deployment frameworks using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent technologies.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, provide architectural guidance, mentor engineers, and establish engineering standards.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience developing and operating enterprise-grade data quality, governance, and data stewardship programs.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to business and executive audiences.

WORKING CONDITIONS
Ability to work in a hybrid environment.
Must be able to travel as required to support business and project initiatives.

PREFERRED SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE

  1. Deep expertise with MDM platform architecture, configuration, administration, and operational support.
  2. Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Master Data Management operating models, governance frameworks, and data product strategies.
  3. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, Databricks, Delta Lake, Lakehouse architecture, and modern data platform ecosystems.
  4. Understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, enterprise integration frameworks, APIs, messaging technologies, and real-time data synchronization patterns.
  5. Experience implementing domain-driven MDM architectures supporting Customer, Shipment, Contact, Location, and Reference Data domains.
  6. Knowledge of enterprise data governance disciplines including metadata management, data lineage, business glossary, data ownership, and stewardship practices.
  7. Experience supporting Medallion Architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and integrating trusted master data into enterprise analytical ecosystems.
  8. Familiarity with data products, data mesh concepts, and modern distributed data ownership models.
  9. Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies, system integration strategies, and cloud modernization initiatives.
  10. Demonstrated ability to balance strategic architecture responsibilities with hands-on engineering and solution delivery.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
Position Description:

The Executive Assistant (EA) is an operational partner within Ren’s shared administrative support pool, providing elevated executive support to assigned senior leaders across the organization. This role exercises independent judgment on matters of significance, proactively manages executive priorities without specific instructions or prescribed procedures, and serves as a trusted decision-maker for operational and administrative matters on behalf of assigned executives.

As part of a shared EA model, this role requires the ability to independently assess competing priorities across multiple executives, make sound judgments about resource allocation and scheduling trade-offs, and take ownership of outcomes with minimal supervision. At least one EA in the pool is designated as the onsite presence at Ren’s Indianapolis headquarters, holding delegated authority for day-to-day office operations in addition to executive support.

The ideal candidate brings a collaborative spirit, excellent communication skills, and advanced proficiency with AI and modern productivity tools. They use judgment to anticipate needs and resolve issues proactively, build trusted working relationships across the organization, and operate with the ownership mindset of a true operational partner to senior leadership.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Executive Calendar & Schedule Support: Manage calendars for assigned executives, making autonomous judgments about scheduling priorities, trade-offs, and time allocation. Resolve conflicts and competing demands without routine escalation, representing executives’ interests in scheduling decisions. Proactively identify calendar inefficiencies and implement improvements.
  • Communication Support: Independently draft, finalize, and send correspondence on behalf of assigned executives, exercising judgment about tone, content, and appropriate response without requiring executive review for routine communications. Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, making decisions about information sharing and escalation. Leverage AI-assisted drafting tools to maximize quality and efficiency.
  • Meeting Coordination: Own end-to-end meeting preparation and follow-through with delegated authority to determine agenda priorities, structure pre-read materials, and support decisions about logistics. Capture, synthesize, and distribute action items, exercising judgment about appropriate follow-up, escalation, and accountability tracking without specific instructions from executives.
  • Travel Arrangements: Manage complex, multi-leg domestic and international travel for assigned executives, exercising judgment on vendor selection, cost trade-offs, and contingency planning without requiring executive input on routine decisions. Anticipate travel needs, maintain preferred vendor relationships, and make real-time adjustments when disruptions occur. Ensure all arrangements align with company policy and executive preferences.
  • AI-Assisted Productivity: Serve as an advanced practitioner of AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT), independently evaluating and implementing workflows for drafting, research, summarization, and task automation.
  • Office Management (Designated Onsite EA): For the EA designated to be onsite at Ren’s Indianapolis headquarters: hold delegated authority for day-to-day office operations, making decisions about vendor selection, supply procurement, facilities issues, and visitor management within prescribed procedures or defining if none exisit. Proactively identify and resolve operational gaps, negotiate with service vendors within established budget parameters, and escalate only those issues requiring executive-level authority.
  • Document & Information Management: Design, own, and maintain documentation systems and information architecture for assigned executives, exercising independent judgment about structure, access, and retention. Identify gaps in existing systems and implement improvements without requiring direction. Prepare and finalize high-stakes documents and presentations with minimal executive input on content and format decisions.
  • Expense Reporting: Independently manage the full expense cycle for assigned executives, including reviewing expenditures for policy compliance, making judgments about appropriate categorization, and resolving discrepancies without routine escalation. Monitor budget adherence and proactively flag anomalies or trends to the EBP.
  • Event Support: Lead end-to-end planning and execution for executive events, leadership offsites, and company-wide initiatives, exercising independent judgment on vendor selection, budget allocation, logistics, and contingency planning. Make real-time decisions during events and serve as the primary decision-maker for operational matters within delegated scope.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work cooperatively with other EAs in the shared pool, coordinating coverage, sharing information, and aligning on priorities to deliver consistent, high-quality support across the organization.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as an authorized representative of assigned executives with internal and external stakeholders, exercising independent judgment about information sharing, commitments, and escalation. Build and maintain trust-based relationships that enable the EA to act on behalf of executives on matters of significance. Exercise discretion in handling confidential business, personnel, and strategic information.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience:

  • Associate’s degree required; Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 2–4 years of executive support experience in a professional environment, with a demonstrated history of operating independently and making decisions on behalf of senior leaders without routine supervision.
  • Prior experience supporting multiple executives or working in a shared services model required.
  • Working familiarity with AI productivity tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) for drafting, summarizing, and research. Comfortable adopting new tools and incorporating them into daily workflows.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent executives professionally in correspondence and interactions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the demonstrated ability to independently prioritize and manage complex, competing workstreams across multiple executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and integrity.
  • Comfortable navigating shifting priorities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Willing to step into new assignments and flex across different executives’ needs as part of the shared EA pool.
  • Proficient with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams). Familiarity with expense management or project management tools is a plus.
  • Onsite Role: For the onsite-designated EA: prior experience supporting office operations, managing supplies or vendors, or serving as an office point of contact is preferred.

Ren is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Job Summary: Leads cross-functional and cross-opco teams of professionals through all phases of the project lifecycle. Manages and directs projects or initiative to ensure that project(s) are delivered on time, within budget and meeting or exceeding customer expectations. Manages either of the following: Single major initiative, defined as a project that is approved and prioritized on the FedEx Project Approval Committee portfolio or a strategic corporate initiative, or multiple projects of various sizes

Essential Functions

  • Adheres to project standards and requirements including the Global Development Process or Everest processes. Ensures all projects impacting FedEx operations follows the FedEx Organizational Change Management (OCM) framework and requirements for the project
  • Ensures scope of project is clearly defined, approved, and has a documented management level sponsor. Develops, manages, tracks progress of, and updates project plan to meet the approved requirements/scope defined for the project. Escalates project issues to upper management.
  • Creates and manages the project schedule by defining tasks and determining the durations, sequencing, and resources needed.
  • Estimates project spending, provides input on budgeting, and controls cost throughout the project lifecycle. Defines and manages project plan to meet the approved scope of the project. Ensures changes in scope are reviewed and approved by project team and sponsors.
  • Defines and tracks success and accuracy metrics for the project to ensure FedEx Quality standards are enforced. Leads cross-functional team(s) to ensure all team members have clearly defined roles and responsibilities while monitoring the progress and performance.
  • Communicates project status to team members and project sponsors on a consistent basis. Ensures effective communication and training is provided to all impacted stakeholders in accordance with FedEx OCM process.
  • Manages the purchase and acquisition of products or services to meet project deliverables in adherence with FedEx policy.
  • Ensures development of risk plan and mitigation strategy. Monitors execution of that strategy. Ensures that Business Requirements Specifications (BRS) and FedEx Work Requests (FWRs) are created to support business needs within the project.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Science, Business, Finance, or related field required. In addition to minimum experience, high school diploma or GED and four (4) years of experience in a technical or professional position is accepted in lieu of degree.

Five (5) years experience required in a technical or professional environment with at least two (2) years of leading cross-functional projects.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

job.title: Director, Campaign Engineering
job.description:
TITLE:

Director, Campaign Engineering

LOCATION:

New York

FOCUS:

Data & Technology

REPORT TO:

SVP, Technology

GROUP:

Technology


ABOUT RAPP

WHO WE ARE

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As a global next-generation precision marketing agency, we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that values diversity and emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help to create value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.

Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.

Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

OUR CLIENTS

From creating inspiring experiences behind the wheel, to defining the future of online learning, and everything in between, we provide smart solutions for companies like Toyota, AAA, PNC Bank, US Army, University of Phoenix and more.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking an experienced and strategic leader to serve as the Director of Campaign Engineering. This individual will oversee a team of Campaign engineers and Decision Support Analysts globally (onshore, nearshore, offshore) working across various marketing automation platforms, including Adobe Campaign Classic, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Acoustic, Redpoint, and others. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving operational excellence, fostering innovation, and ensuring the successful execution of marketing campaigns across diverse tools and technologies.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Team Leadership and Development:

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Campaign Engineers and Decision Support Analysts to achieve departmental and organizational goals.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, adherence to best practices and continuous improvement within the team.

  • Conduct regular performance reviews and support professional development initiatives.

  • Strategic Planning and Execution:

  • Develop and implement a strategic vision for campaign engineering, aligning with broader marketing objectives.

  • Ensure optimal utilization of marketing automation platforms to deliver personalized and impactful campaigns efficiently.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless campaign execution and alignment with business priorities.

  • Platform and Process Optimization:

  • Oversee the configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization of various marketing automation tools.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve efficiencies, and enhance campaign effectiveness.

  • Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure the team remains at the forefront of marketing automation capabilities.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Leverage data analytics to inform campaign strategies, measure effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Provide insights and recommendations to stakeholders based on campaign performance metrics and audience engagement trends.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration:

  • Act as a key liaison between the campaign engineering team and other departments, including marketing, IT, and data science.

  • Build and democratize self-service dashboards to allow client, account and marketing teams to know how their campaigns are doing both operationally and performance-wise.

  • Partner with stakeholders to define business requirements and translate them into actionable technical solutions.

  • Compliance and Governance:

  • Ensure all campaigns comply with data privacy regulations and organizational policies.

  • Implement best practices to safeguard the integrity and security of customer data.

  • Operational Excellence:

  • Ensure the team is fully adhering to processes, peer-reviews, quality checklists, in order to deliver the highest quality of execution.

  • Design processes to ensure campaigns (both adhoc and automated) are monitored closely and issues are pre-emptively handled.

  • Participate into campaign diagnostics and root cause analysis if any issue arises.

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Educational Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Advanced degree is a plus.

  • Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in marketing automation, campaign management, or related fields.

  • 3+ years in a leadership role managing cross-functional or technical teams.

  • Proven expertise with multiple marketing automation platforms, including Adobe Campaign Classic, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and others.

  • Technical Skills:

  • Experience writing complex SQL statements and mapping relational database structures

  • Solid experience building custom audiences and automations within an Enterprise campaign management solution such as Adobe Campaign Classic, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Acoustic, Braze, Marketo. Leveraging both in-platform audience creation tools as well as custom query languages when available.

  • Strong understanding of Marketing Campaign execution process (strategy, audience definition, creative development, testing, fulfilment/deployment, monitoring, reporting)

  • Experience building and / or managing complex multi-channel journeys in-platform is a plus.

  • Experience working with programming languages such as Python, R, Scala to ingest and manipulate data.

  • Demonstrated experience automating the preparation and distribution of critical data (audiences, kpis) to other teams.

  • Understanding of distributing computing (Apache Spark) to manipulate large data sets.

  • Leadership Skills:

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire teams to achieve high performance.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a multi-platform environment with diverse campaign requirements.

  • Knowledge of agile project management methodologies.

  • Strong understanding of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

OUR HYBRID WORKING MODEL

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

  • Lead incident response activities as needed, assisting in the prompt resolution and mitigation of security incidents.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures
  • Perform other duties as required

job.title: Technical Architect
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:
Provides enterprise-level architectural leadership across compute, storage, network, cloud, and application platforms. Responsible for developing architecture blueprints, reference designs, standards, and patterns that guide engineering and operational teams.
ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:
1.    Develop and maintain architecture blueprints, reference architectures, design standards, and platform patterns to ensure consistency and scalability across enterprise systems.
2.    Translate business requirements into technical architecture, ensuring alignment with strategy, security controls, operational readiness, and lifecycle plans.
3.    Lead end-to-end solution design for infrastructure, platforms, data center technologies, and mission-critical systems.
4.    Conduct architectural assessments, gap analyses, and technology evaluations to recommend improvements and modernization opportunities.
5.    Collaborate with engineering, operations, and product teams to ensure solutions are designed for resiliency, performance, efficiency, and supportability.
6.    Provide architectural governance and oversight during solution development, implementation, and transition to operations.
7.    Create detailed design documents, diagrams, and technical specifications supporting platform engineering and implementation work.
8.    Establish technology standards, best practices, and guardrails to ensure secure and compliant deployments across platforms.
9.    Evaluate new technologies, tools, platforms, and vendors, providing guidance on adoption strategies and long-term roadmap impacts.
10.    Support capacity planning, performance engineering, and reliability engineering efforts to ensure architecture scalability and sustainability.
11.    Participate in incident and problem management by contributing root cause analysis and architectural recommendations to prevent recurrence.
12.    Lead architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical workshops with stakeholders across IT and business units.
13.    Guide automation, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code integration throughout architecture designs and engineering processes.
14.    Contribute to disaster recovery, redundancy, and continuity strategies, ensuring architectural alignment with enterprise resilience goals.
15.    Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.
16.    Perform other duties as assigned. 
Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.
